Hi, I’m Peter, VP of Networks at Airalo!

Our team ensures customers have instant, smooth connectivity from the moment they purchase their plan to the moment they arrive at their destination. We go beyond standard mobile service, building innovative solutions that enhance the traveller experience. We’re looking for curious engineers who want to design the future of global networks. Think outside the box, reverse-engineer solutions from ambitious product ideas, and help pave the way for Airalo’s leadership as a global connectivity partner.

Airalo’s fully remote Networks team is growing. You’ll work on the systems and infrastructure that keep over 20 million travellers connected reliably and securely at global scale. Solve complex technical challenges, optimize processes, and experiment with better ways to keep the world connected.

As our Senior HLR/HSS Specialist, you are the guardian of our subscriber data and the architect of our roaming efficiency. You won't just manage databases; you will own the life-cycle of HSS/HLR templates that allow our MVNO to scale globally. Your expertise in Profile & Template Engineering is critical to our success in maximising COGS and margin through sophisticated Steering of Roaming (SoR) and Sponsor Roaming integrations.

Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Design and maintain HLR/HSS subscriber templates, ensuring precise configuration of roaming profiles, APN/PDN contexts, and Camel/Diameter triggers.
  • Collaborate with roaming partners to implement and refine SoR logic within the HLR/HSS, ensuring subscribers attach to preferred networks based on cost and quality.
  • Lead the technical deployment of Full MVNO profiles, managing specific QoS profiles and addressing (GTs, APNs) required for independent network operations.
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for our System Integrators, auditing HLR/HSS configurations, reviewing change requests, and ensuring alignment with the 2026 roadmap.
  • Define and monitor critical HLR/HSS KPIs, including Location Update (LU) success rates and Diameter Transaction per Second (TPS) limits.

What you’ll need:

  • Deep technical mastery of MAP (SS7) and Diameter (S6a/S13) protocols; additional experience with VoLTE Roaming (S8HR) or SMSoIP rollout is a significant advantage.
  • Subscriber Mapping: Extensive experience with HLR, HSS, and UDM (User Data Management) in a multi-tenant or MVNO/E environment.
  • Practical experience with Multi-IMSI applets and the logic required to manage roaming through Sponsor IMSIs.
  • A solid understanding of GSMA IREG (IR series); familiarity with TADIG (TD series) and how HSS/HLR templates impact billing/settlement is preferred.
  • A "detective" mindset for troubleshooting complex signalling failures using tools like Wireshark or roaming-specific platforms (e.g., Mobileum, Roamware, or SIGOS).
  • Proven ability to manage technical projects with external System Integrators and roaming partners under tight deadlines.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with 5G Unified Data Management (UDM) and Authentication Server Functions (AUSF).
  • Knowledge of Cloud Native Network Functions (CNF) and containerised core deployments.
  • Scripting skills (Python/Bash) for automating provisioning audits or log parsing.

Autodesk is seeking an operationally focused Director of Talent Development to lead the execution and delivery of our global Talent Development function, ensuring effective program management, cross-functional coordination, operational consistency, and innovation while supporting Autodesk’s evolution as an AI-native organization grounded in our OneORBIT culture.

Serving an enterprise of 16,000 employees globally, the Director will ensure scalable programs are planned, coordinated, and delivered effectively to advance employee growth, leadership capabilities, talent readiness, organizational strategy, innovation, and the integration of AI into how individuals learn, lead, and work.

This role is ideal for a leader who combines deep expertise in learning experience and systems with operational discipline, program management capabilities, and a focus on execution excellence. jobs.description:
Ready to make travel easier for millions? Airalo is the world’s first and largest eSIM store, helping travellers stay connected seamlessly in over 200 countries and regions. We trust our teams to take ownership, put customers first, and do work that has a real impact every day. What’s in it for you? Airalo offers team members a range of perks, including remote work, generous PTO, wellness and learning allowances, and, of course, our annual Airalo Away retreat. Learn more about our benefits here;

Hi, I'm Daniele, VP of Engineering at Airalo!

Engineering drives Airalo’s eSIM platform. We build the product that lets millions of people connect instantly across the globe. The challenges are exciting: high-scale systems, carrier integrations, and products spanning both B2C and B2B. What matters most to us is creating an environment where engineers can do their best work. Real ownership, autonomy, and a direct link between what you ship and business outcomes are key. You’ll work with smart, motivated people who take their craft seriously. If you want to build things that matter at global scale, this is where you do it.

Airalo’s fully remote Engineering team in Spain is growing. In this role, you'll tackle complex technical challenges across our product ecosystem, helping build, innovate, and scale the platform that keeps millions of travellers connected worldwide.

We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing engineering team.

We are a company that values SRE principles and practices. We believe in empowering our SREs to make data-driven decisions, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve the reliability of our systems. We foster a blameless culture where everyone is encouraged to learn from mistakes and share knowledge. If you are passionate about building and maintaining highly reliable systems, we would love to hear from you!

On Call

    Participating in our on-call rotation is a core expectation of this role. It's essential for maintaining 24/7 service reliability across our global operations, ensuring our systems remain resilient and our customers experience uninterrupted service, regardless of time zone or geography.
    - Paid Rotation: We offer standby fees + overtime pay.
    - Delayed Start: No on-call duties for your first 6 months.
    - Rest & Recovery: Guaranteed rest periods and flexible hours following night incidents.
    - Shared Load: Rotations are split (Weekdays vs. Weekends) to minimize fatigue.
    Please refer to the On-Call Policy in the Airalo Handbook for full details:

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the design of scalable, fault-tolerant and self-healing systems in a multi-region AWS environment.
  • Define and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) to drive architectural decisions and error budget policies.
  • Conduct blameless post-incident reviews to uncover systemic root causes and implement long-term preventive measures.
  • Identify patterns of manual work and lead the development of internal tools/automation to permanently eliminate them.
  • Develop and maintain automated runbooks and playbooks for common operational tasks and complex incident response.
  • Shift from simple monitoring to deep observability, ensuring high cardinality data leads to proactive actionable insights.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate operational risks through chaos engineering and architecture reviews.
  • Work with software engineers to design systems for reliability, scalability, and maintainability from the early stages of the SDLC.
  • Continuously evaluate and optimize system performance, capacity, and cost efficiency.
  • Beyond just participating, you will refine the on-call experience to reduce alert fatigue, improve MTTR, and ensure sustainable rotation health.

Must-haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering or a similar discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Site Reliability Engineer or in a similar role.
  • 3+ years of experience with AWS services including strong knowledge of container orchestration.
  • 2+ years of Kubernetes experience
  • Deep understanding of observability principles and tools such as: Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry and similar.
  • Experience with leading incident management and complex postmortem analysis.
  • Experience and interest in managing infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Experience with chaos engineering and other techniques for testing system resilience.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions for automated delivery.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, Java, etc.) for building automation and internal tooling.
  • Event-driven architecture experience (SNS, SQS etc)
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Team player and open to new ideas.
  • Good communication skills and fluency in English.

Good to have:

  • Prior experience with Scrum and other agile methods.
  • Certification in relevant areas such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or similar.
  • Prior experience with Telco Core Networks (e.g., 5G/LTE Packet Core, IMS, Signaling) and low-latency networking.
  • Experience with AI-driven SRE tools for anomaly detection and improvements
  • Contributions to open-source SRE projects or communities.
  • Prior work experience in telecommunications.

jobs.title: Director of Quality Assurance
jobs.excerpt: About Comfrt: Comfrt is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.
jobs.description:
About Comfrt:
Comfrt is the #1 Hoodie Brand in the U.S. and the #1 apparel and home textile brand on TikTok globally. We design and deliver elevated basics rooted in mental well-being, comfort, and confidence. With over 4 million hoodies sold in just two years, we're expanding rapidly across apparel, home textile, and lifestyle categories — as well as into new international markets and retail channels. We're looking for a visionary Director of Quality Assurance to lead and scale our global quality organization across every product category we touch.


About the Role:
The Director of Quality Assurance is a senior leadership role responsible for building, scaling, and leading Comfrt's global quality function across both apparel and home textile categories. This position sets the strategic direction for quality across all product categories and global markets, ensuring our vendor base — particularly overseas manufacturing partners — meets and exceeds compliance and quality standards across the U.S., EU, Canada, Australia, and all emerging international markets.

The Director will partner closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams — including Product Development, Technical Design, and Retail Operations — to embed quality at every stage of the product lifecycle, from concept through final delivery. This role is critical to Comfrt's continued global growth and its commitment to delivering products that reflect our brand promise of comfort, quality, and confidence.


Key Responsibilities:
Strategic QA Leadership & Organizational Development
  • Own and drive the global QA strategy, frameworks, SOPs, and compliance standards across all vendors, categories, and countries of production — spanning both apparel and home textile product lines
  • Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing QA team — both internal staff and external partners — to support Comfrt's rapid global expansion
  • Establish scalable QA infrastructure and systems capable of supporting significant growth across new product categories and international markets
  • Influence senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to maintain quality as a core pillar of Comfrt's brand promise
  • Define and track KPIs for quality performance across the global supply chain, with regular executive reporting
Global Compliance & International Market Standards
  • Serve as Comfrt's subject-matter expert on apparel and home textile quality, safety, and regulatory compliance across all key international markets, including:
    • United States: CPSC, ASTM, CPSIA, FLSA, CA Prop 65, 16 CFR flammability standards for home textiles
    • European Union: REACH, GPSD, Textile Labeling Regulation, EN safety standards, EU Ecodesign regulations
    • Canada: CCPSA, Canada Consumer Product Safety Act, bilingual labeling requirements, Hazardous Products Act
    • Australia/New Zealand: ACCC, product safety standards, mandatory labeling laws
    • UK: UKCA marking, UK REACH, retained EU compliance post-Brexit, UK Furniture & Furnishings Fire Safety Regulations
    • Emerging markets as Comfrt continues international expansion
  • Proactively monitor and interpret evolving regulatory landscapes across international markets, assessing impact on product development, sourcing, and labeling strategies
  • Partner with Legal, Sourcing, and Product Development to ensure compliance is built into every product from inception, not retrofitted at the point of shipment
  • Lead international labeling strategy — including care labels, fiber content disclosure, country of origin, flammability warnings, and multilingual requirements — ensuring accuracy and compliance across all target markets for both apparel and home textile products
Retail & Channel Compliance
  • Develop and enforce compliance programs aligned with the requirements of major retail partners, including big-box, department store, specialty, and international retail channels
  • Own vendor compliance requirements for retail accounts, including routing guides, packaging standards, ticketing and labeling specs, and social compliance requirements
  • Partner with Merchandising teams to prepare for retail audits and compliance reviews, ensuring Comfrt consistently meets or exceeds retailer expectations across both apparel and home textile assortments
  • Oversee compliance for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and e-commerce channels, ensuring packaging, labeling, and product presentation meet platform and regulatory requirements
  • Establish and maintain documentation and reporting structures to support retail partners' vendor compliance programs
Quality Standards & Benchmarking — Apparel & Home Textile
  • Establish, document, and continuously evolve Comfrt's quality benchmarks across all product categories:
    • Apparel: Casual, Athleisure, Sleep, Activewear, Kids & Pet Apparel
    • Home Textile: Blankets, Throws, Pillows, Robes, Towels, Bedding, Cushions, and other soft home goods
    • Accessories: Handbags, Luggage, and lifestyle accessories
  • Define category-specific quality standards that address the unique performance requirements of home textiles — including pilling resistance, wash durability, shrinkage, fiber shedding, colorfastness, seam strength, and fill power for down/alternative fill products
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive quality assurance, testing, and inspection protocols aligned with both brand standards and market-specific regulatory requirements for each product category
  • Develop QA standards and protocols for new categories
  • Implement a Sealed Sample program and centralized approved sample library to ensure consistent inspection standards across all third-party and in-house inspections
Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement
  • Lead rapid root cause analysis for quality issues and drive corrective action plan management with vendors and internal teams
  • Champion a continuous improvement culture across the global supply chain, leveraging data and field insights to proactively prevent quality failures
  • Develop escalation protocols and crisis response frameworks for critical quality events, including potential recalls or market withdrawals
  • Analyze defect trends across product categories — including home textile-specific issues such as fiber shedding, delamination, fill migration, and thermal performance failures — and drive systemic fixes
Vendor Compliance & Performance Management
  • Own global vendor performance management, including quality scorecards, audits, corrective action plans, and ongoing factory evaluations across both apparel and home textile supply chains
  • Enforce adherence to quality standards across overseas vendors and factories in China, Vietnam, Cambodia, and other sourcing regions
  • Lead vendor training programs to build quality capability and compliance knowledge across the supply base, including specialized training for home textile manufacturers on fiber standards, filling materials, and construction requirements
  • Evaluate and onboard third-party inspection firms and accredited testing laboratories; define scope, manage relationships, and hold partners accountable to performance standards
Testing & Compliance Operations
  • Establish and maintain robust testing protocols ensuring all products meet performance, durability, safety, and regulatory standards across all applicable markets
  • Manage relationships with accredited testing laboratories and third-party inspection firms globally
  • Ensure all testing is conducted at accredited laboratories compliant with applicable market standards (OEKO-TEX, bluesign, or equivalent certifications where relevant)
  • Manage the expectations and schedule of 3rd party Asia QA team
Inspection Management
  • Manage the end-to-end inspection lifecycle: pre-production meetings, in-line inspections, size set approvals, and final inspections across all product categories
  • Ensure all third-party final inspections are conducted with properly established Sealed Samples and approved tech packs present
  • Define inspection criteria, AQL standards, and hold/release protocols appropriate to each product category — with specific criteria for home textile construction, filling, finishing, and packaging requirements
  • Oversee inspection of packaging compliance for home textile products, including labeling, care instructions, fiber content declarations, and country of origin accuracy
Documentation, Reporting & Visibility
  • Develop and maintain QA SOPs, inspection reports, compliance documentation, and quality dashboards across all product categories
  • Provide cross-functional teams — including Merchandising, Sourcing, Finance, and executive leadership — with timely, actionable quality visibility
  • Maintain comprehensive records to support retailer compliance audits, regulatory inquiries, and internal reviews
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Training
  • Partner with Product Development, Technical Design, Sourcing, and Operations to ensure quality is built in from concept through production to final inspection — for both apparel and home textile development pipelines
  • Collaborate with the Design and PD teams during the home textile development process to ensure fiber selection, construction methods, and finishing treatments meet both aesthetic intent and quality/compliance standards
  • Lead quality training programs for internal teams and vendor partners to continuously elevate standards and build organizational capability
  • Collaborate with international business development and retail teams to ensure QA readiness for new market entries and retail account launches
Skills & Qualifications
Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in quality assurance/quality control within apparel and/or home textile manufacturing
  • Experience across both soft goods categories strongly preferred — apparel AND home textiles (blankets, bedding, pillows, throws, towels, robes, or similar)
  • 10+ years of people management experience, with a demonstrated track record of building and scaling QA teams
  • Extensive experience working with overseas vendors across China, Vietnam, Cambodia, and other global sourcing regions
  • Proven experience managing quality across multiple international markets simultaneously (US, EU, Canada, Australia, UK)
  • Experience supporting major retail accounts and navigating retailer compliance programs
  • Background in both DTC/e-commerce and wholesale/retail channels strongly preferred.
Technical Knowledge
  • Expert knowledge of U.S., EU, Canada, Australia, and UK quality, safety, and regulatory compliance standards for both apparel and home textile products
  • Strong working knowledge of home textile-specific testing standards: AATCC, ASTM home textile methods, flammability standards (16 CFR 1610, 16 CFR 1632/1633 where applicable), and fill material regulations
  • Familiarity with sustainable textile certifications (OEKO-TEX Standard 100, GOTS, bluesign, Responsible Down Standard) as they apply to home textile and apparel products
  • Deep fluency in international labeling requirements — including care labels, fiber content, country of origin, flammability disclosures, and multilingual compliance across target markets
  • Proven ability to conduct vendor audits, factory inspections, and targeted vendor training programs
  • Strong understanding of retail routing, packaging, and vendor compliance requirements across major retail channels
Leadership & Communication
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and inspire a QA team while influencing senior stakeholders and driving organizational change
  • Exceptional ability to synthesize complex, fast-moving information — connecting signals from vendors, the field, and internal teams into clear, actionable direction
  • Proactive in formulating approaches to QA issue resolution and keeping all stakeholders aligned on problem status, remediation trajectory, and resolution
  • Superior fluency with digital communication tools (Slack, WhatsApp, Google Meet, Zoom) and analytical tools (MS Excel, Google Sheets), with the ability to coach team members on effective use
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones
Other Requirements
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally for vendor visits, factory audits, inspections, and retail partner meetings
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and leadership skills across vendor, retail, and internal teams
  • Solutions-driven mindset with a strong sense of urgency and accountability
  • Can operate successfully in Fast pace high sku count business

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

This is position reports into the Chief Growth Officer. You will shape the PMM function, set the strategic direction for how we bring our connectivity to market, and directly drive adoption, engagement, and monetization across the Airalo lifecycle.

What you'll do:

  • Ensure consistency between product value and how it's communicated externally.

    • Go-To-Market Strategy & Customer Insights

  • Where relevant, develop partner-specific GTM motions in coordination with the Partnerships team.

  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of Airalo's customers, segments, and buying behaviors.

  • Commission and synthesize market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback to inform product and marketing strategy.

  • Serve as the internal voice of the customer across Product, Marketing, and Leadership.

    • Product Adoption & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Drive strategies to increase activation, engagement, upsell, and retention across the customer lifecycle.

  • Work with CRM, Growth and Product to design lifecycle campaigns grounded in product value and behavioral data.

  • Identify and close gaps between product capability and customer awareness/usage.

This is a remote position.

Business Operations Manager - Job Description
Employment Type:Full-time, Remote
Reports To: Founder & CEO
Working Hours: Aligned to AEST business hours
About the Opportunity
Remote Office is a global talent infrastructure company helping Australian businesses build and manage high-performing offshore teams. Shift AI is an execution infrastructure company that helps businesses scale through intentional automation and AI agent deployment.
Both businesses are growing. As for the Founder of the businesses, the time needs to move toward building - not running. This role exists to take the operational layer off entirely.
The person in this seat will own execution across two businesses - covering operations, finance, people, compliance, and commercial function. This is not a coordination role. It is an ownership role. You will make decisions, hold accountability, and drive outcomes without needing to be managed.
If you are looking for a role where your manager tells you what to do next, this is not it. If you are someone who sees the gap, fills it, and reports back with the outcome - read on.
What You Will Own
Operations & Execution
  • Drive organisational performance across both businesses by coordinating with the sales team, setting targets, and tracking delivery against those targets
  • Manage HR project management across the full talent lifecycle - structure, compliance, documentation, advisory, and escalation
  • Handle people management matters including disputes and sensitive situations; escalate only what genuinely requires the Founder's involvement
  • Be the practising custodian of organisational culture - you model it, reinforce it, and hold the team to it
Finance & Commercial
  • Execute financial transactions and maintain clean financial records in coordination with the accounts team
  • Own client invoicing - accuracy, timeliness, and follow-through are non-negotiable
  • Own all tool and software subscription management - renewals, cancellations, cost reviews
  • Optimise operational costs and contribute to pricing and cost strategy across both businesses
  • Formulate talent cost strategy across regions, accounting for market rates, compliance obligations, and business margins
  • Handle corporate structure matters and tax planning with appropriate professional stakeholders
Legal & Contracts
  • Draft, review, and manage commercial contracts, contractor agreements, service agreements, and internal employment documentation
  • Make sound commercial and compliance decisions within your authority; flag edge cases appropriately
Communication & Presentation
  • Prepare business presentations for internal and external use as required - Canva proficiency is expected
  • Collaborate regularly with clients, team members, and relevant external parties in a professional and clear manner
What We Are Looking For
Non-negotiables
  • Fluent English - written and spoken; your communication must be clear, precise, and professional
  • Demonstrable experience across operations, finance, and HR - not one of these, all of them
  • A decision-maker, not a task-taker - you must be comfortable owning outcomes
  • High integrity and discretion - you will be handling sensitive financial, legal, and people matters
  • Systems thinker - you see processes, not just tasks; you build for durability, not convenience
Strong Edge
  • Proficiency with AI tools and automation - ClickUp, Slack, Zoho Books, and AI agents
  • Experience working across multi-entity or cross-border business structures
  • Familiarity with Australian business compliance context
  • Contract drafting experience beyond templates
The Kind of Person We Are Looking For
The title is Operations Manager. The reality is closer to a business partner.
We value calm over urgency, clarity over volume, and ownership over effort. We do not reward heroics - we reward systems. If you are the kind of person who builds the right process and then lets it run, you will fit here.
What You Can Expect
  • A role with genuine scope and real decision-making authority
  • Direct access to the Founder - you are not buried in a hierarchy
  • A team that values clarity, ownership, and doing things properly
  • The tools, structure, and context to do your job well - not just the title
Remote Office and Shift AI are equal opportunity employers. We hire based on capability, character, and fit - nothing else.

About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

Job Description

The Field Service Specialist II is an experienced field professional responsible for the commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimization of Copeland control systems and refrigeration equipment. This role demands a deep understanding of refrigeration system operation, control strategies, and integration with HVAC and building management systems. Field work will be required with extensive overnight travel. The Field Services Specialist II is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport and communications with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives, and others as appropriate. 

 

AS A FIELD SERVICE SPECIALIST II, YOU WILL:

  • Commission and verify control systems for refrigeration and HVAC applications (E2, E3, Site Supervisors,etc). 

  • Troubleshoot system issues both on-site and remotely, ensuringoptimalperformance. 

  • Develop andmodifycontroller programs from I/O legends or existing sequences. 

  • Execute new store commissioning and remodel commissioning projects, ensuring all documentation is completed accurately. 

  • Provide site-level customer support and training for contractors and end users. 

  • Review and interpret store prints, electrical schematics, and project specifications. 

  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Engineers, and Technical Support on project execution. 

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of third-party control systems and network integrations. 

  • Ensure all work meets safety and compliance standards. 

 

REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, & SKILLS:

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on field experience in refrigeration, controls, or commissioning. 

  • Advanced understanding of refrigeration cycle operation (compressors, valves, racks, cases). 

  • Knowledge of building automation systems and HVAC control logic. 

  • CO₂trans-criticalor cascade system experience highly preferred. 

  • Proficiencywith Modbus, BACnet, and other communication protocols preferred.  

  • Computer skills including Microsoft Office products, databases, Internet software, E-mail, Windows, etc.  

  • Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple site assignments. 

  • Ability to travel up to 85–90%. 

  • Legal work authorization in the United States - Sponsorship will not be provided for this role 

Remote Work Arrangement:  

This role is fully remote. As a remote colleague, you maybe requiredto travel to a Copeland site regularly to collaborate with your team or customers as needed. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Snef

AtSnef, we’re redefining how creators transform passion into prosperity. Our platform is built for those who dream big and think differently:

  • Earn More, Connect Better:Collaborate with sought-after brands, open new revenue streams, and expand your influence.

  • Find Your Creative Community:Engage with fellow creators, exchange fresh ideas, and gain inspiration from a thriving network.

  • Leverage AI & Automation:Streamline your entire content-to-commerce journey, so you can spend more time doing what you do best—creating.

This isn’t just another platform. It’s a dynamic ecosystem designed to empower your creativity, fuel your growth, and help you thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Junior QA Engineer at Snef, you will ensure that our cutting-edge web applications—built with Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript—deliver seamless, engaging experiences for our creator community. You’ll be at the forefront of ensuring platform quality, helping creators monetize their work, access premium brand opportunities, and harness powerful AI-driven automation. This is your chance to grow, innovate, and directly impact how creators succeed online.

What You’ll Do

  • Manual & Functional Testing:

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing across our web applications.

    • Validate new features and enhancements, ensuring a frictionless user experience for creators.

  • Test Automation & CI/CD Integration:

    • Develop, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts using TypeScript-based frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Selenium WebDriver).

    • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks.

  • API & Performance Testing:

    • Test RESTful services using Postman or similar tools, guaranteeing reliable, scalable API endpoints.

    • (Nice to have) Support performance testing using JMeter to ensure our platform scales with our creators’ growth.

  • Defect Management & Collaboration:

    • Log, track, and manage defects using tools like JIRA or TestRail.

    • Work closely with developers, product managers, and UX designers to refine requirements, address issues, and deliver elegant solutions that meet our creators’ needs.

  • Agile & Continuous Improvement:

    • Participate in Agile ceremonies—daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives—to ensure transparent communication and iterative progress.

    • Stay updated with industry trends, AI-driven testing methods, and emerging best practices, continually seeking ways to enhance our testing processes.


Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience & Skills:

    • 2+ years of combined manual and automation testing experience.

    • Proven expertise in testing web applications built with Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

    • Proficiency in TypeScript-based automation tools (Cypress or similar) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.

    • Experience with bug tracking/test management tools (JIRA, TestRail).

  • Technical Knowledge:

    • Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.

    • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Soft Skills:

    • Detail-oriented mindset and a passion for quality.

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    • Collaborative spirit and adaptability in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Nice-to-Haves:

    • Performance testing (JMeter) experience.

    • An interest in the creator economy, social commerce, or AI-driven solutions.


Benefits

Why Join Snef?

  • Empower Creators:Your work supports an ecosystem where creators monetize their passions, connect with premium brands, and scale their businesses.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology:Embrace modern frameworks, AI-driven automation, and continuous innovation.

  • Professional Growth:Access opportunities for learning, experimentation, and career advancement in a rapidly evolving startup.

  • Collaborative Culture:Join a diverse, inclusive team that values open communication, shared knowledge, and mutual success.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re excited about delivering high-quality digital experiences, enabling creators to thrive, and working with forward-thinking technology, we want to hear from you. Join Snef in Jakarta and shape the future of social commerce.Send us your resumeand let’s build something extraordinary together!

Deploying your combination of architectural experience and deep medical imaging domain knowledge, you'll translate product strategy and business objectives into solution‑level architectural direction, aligning multiple domains, teams and stakeholders around a unified technical vision. You'll be responsible for product‑wide architectural consistency, non‑functional requirements, security and regulatory alignment and technical risk management. jobs.title: Product Developer
jobs.excerpt: At Comfrt, product is at the center of everything we do.
jobs.description:
At Comfrt, product is at the center of everything we do. Our goal is to build a category-defining brand that delivers comfort, quality, and innovation at scale.

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly driven Product Developer to support the execution and scaling of our product categories from concept through production. Partnering closely with design, sourcing, and production teams, you will bring innovative, high-quality products to market while ensuring development timelines, cost targets, and brand standards are met.

The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and product-obsessed — someone with deep technical knowledge of materials, construction, and manufacturing processes who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

This role is critical to Comfrt's growth. You will own the development process end-to-end, turning creative concepts into real products that reach hundreds of thousands of customers — executed flawlessly and built to the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Development Execution

  • Own the product development process from concept through production across multiple product categories.
  • Translate design concepts into technically sound and commercially viable products.
  • Develop clear product specifications including materials, trims, construction methods, and functional requirements.
  • Anticipate development challenges early and proactively solve problems before they impact timelines or product quality.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of development calendars and key milestones to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Apply strong aesthetic judgment and product taste level to ensure product aligns with brand standards.
  • Utilize deep knowledge of fabric, construction, and fit to guide development decisions.
  • Review and evaluate prototypes and samples to ensure alignment with design intent, quality standards, and performance expectations.

Vendor & Factory Collaboration

  • Partner with domestic and international vendors to develop prototypes, samples, and pre-production units.
  • Clearly communicate technical requirements and provide actionable feedback to factories.
  • Manage sample tracking, development timelines, and vendor communication across multiple programs.
  • Build strong relationships with factory partners to support efficient product development and execution.

Materials & Trim Development

  • Source and evaluate fabrics, trims, hardware, and components that meet product and cost requirements.
  • Maintain strong knowledge of material performance, durability, and cost implications.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product through better materials or construction techniques.
  • Ensure all materials meet brand standards for quality and performance.

Cost & Margin Management

  • Partner with sourcing teams and vendors to achieve target costs while maintaining product integrity.
  • Review vendor costing and identify opportunities for cost engineering when appropriate.

Timeline & Development Management

  • Maintain development calendars and ensure key milestones are met across all product programs.
  • Maintain a clear understanding of the current product development timeline and identify creative ways to tighten the calendar to accelerate development while maintaining product quality.
  • Manage multi-category development calendars across multiple countries and vendors.
  • Work closely with the Fabric Manager, mills, and trim suppliers to ensure fabric development, lab dips, and trim approvals are completed on schedule.
  • Connect the dots across product, fabric, trims, and factory timelines to ensure all components align and programs stay on track.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across design, sourcing, and production to support on-time product launches.
  • Identify risks early and proactively address issues to keep development moving forward.

Quality & Production Readiness

  • Evaluate samples for fabric, color, construction, durability, functionality, and overall product quality in collaboration with Design and TD.
  • Provide detailed technical feedback to vendors to refine product execution.
  • Approve production samples and ensure factories are prepared for bulk production.
  • Support production teams to ensure development approvals translate successfully into manufacturing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Products move through development quickly and efficiently.
  • Samples arrive accurate and require minimal revisions.
  • Vendors receive clear direction and execute product correctly.
  • Development timelines are consistently met.
  • Product quality, materials, and construction meet or exceed brand standards.

Who You Are:

  • Proactive and solutions-oriented. You anticipate problems and solve them before they slow down development.
  • Product obsessed. You care deeply about product quality, details, and execution.
  • A creative problem solver. You enjoy improving products and processes.
  • Consumer-focused. You think about how the product performs for the end customer.
  • Fast but disciplined. You know how to move quickly while maintaining high standards.
  • Accountable. You take ownership of your work and follow through.
  • Collaborative. You work well cross-functionally and communicate clearly with internal teams and vendors.
  • Comfortable in a high-growth environment. You thrive where expectations are high and priorities move quickly.

Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of product development experience within apparel, accessories, or consumer products.
  • Experience developing soft goods across all categories, apparel, accessories and bags.
  • Strong understanding of fabrics, trims, hardware, and construction techniques.
  • Experience working with overseas vendors and global manufacturing partners.
  • Ability to provide clear visual and technical comments to vendors.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with PLM systems and managing product data.
  • Proficiency in Excel and product development tools.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Why Join Comfrt?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.
Comfrt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

In the meantime, we also invite you to follow us on LinkedIn to engage with our community.

About Potential Project

At Potential Project, our purpose is to create a more human world of work through harnessing the full potential of the mind. In this new world of work, people are focused, calm and resilient, even happy at work. There is time for connection and compassion for one another, even on the busiest days. This new world begins inside, in the mind.

Potential Project is a global research and leadership development firm that partners with leading organizations to uncover the power of the mind – how it is wired and how to rewire it for new behaviors and different outcomes. Through integrating cutting-edge neuroscience, evidence-based research and contemplative practices from the wisdom traditions, we have helped over 450,000 individuals and 500 clients to enhance performance, resilience and creativity and to develop leaders who are more agile, compassionate and courageous.

We are present in 28 countries with a network of 70+ facilitators, and we serve hundreds of forward-thinking companies like McKinsey, IKEA, Unilever, Cisco, LEGO and Microsoft.

You will embrace Potential Project’s Facilitation Disciplines, best practices to deliver leadership development programs in large, global organizations. You will facilitate transformational journeys that enable top teams and leaders at all levels to harness the full potential of their mind and lead with both humanity and performance.

Requirements to become Potential Project facilitator

Qualified candidates should satisfy most of these requirements:


  • Extensive personal mindfulness practice, usually more than five years, including a daily practice and experience attending annual retreats.

  • Participated in at least one, weeklong silent retreat with a qualified meditation teacher.

  • Substantial professional experience with credibility in working at a senior level in the corporate environment, e.g. relevant experience in a consultancy firm; management or executive roles; or as a lecturer with relevant work-life subject matter.

  • Excellent facilitation and training skills, including extensive experience facilitating training for people in work-life and organizing and managing training interventions.

  • The ability and willingness to engage in goal-oriented sales work - including exceptional business acumen, strategic thinking, your own network of contacts and experience in selling services.

Noble Consulting Overview:

As part of the KSM family, Noble Consulting Services, Inc. is a nationwide consulting firm based in Indianapolis providing a full range of services to insurance regulators. Through our deep experience as former regulators, big-4 managers, and insurance industry professionals, as well as highly motivated recent graduates, we are recognized for our understanding of the insurance industry, regulatory environment, and emerging challenges. We serve regulators throughout the nation who trust us in both routine and unique situations.

Position Summary:

The Actuarial Director is responsible for leading actuarial components of financial condition examinations of life insurance companies on behalf of regulatory bodies, other regulatory consulting projects and other insurance related engagements. Operating within a consulting environment, this role serves as the primary actuarial subject matter expert, owning workstreams related to statutory valuation, reserving adequacy, product pricing and actuarial modeling.

For financial examinations, the Actuarial Director supports all seven phases of the risk-focused examination process for the actuarial functions of life and A&H insurers, including but not limited to reserving, pricing, and reinsurance activities. The actuary will be responsible for coordinating, directing, and implementing the actuarial portion of a financial examination, including evaluation of the governance and controls of an insurer’s reserving, pricing and/or reinsurance processes and performance of substantive examination procedures. Other projects include assisting in review of premium rate and policy form filings for state insurance department clients, as well as other projects providing valuation or other actuarial support to both regulatory and non-regulatory clients. This position will primarily relate to companies filing the life and A&H annual statement blank but may also perform services related to health insurers.

The Actuarial Director provides independent, well-supported conclusions regarding insurers’ financial positions, ensuring alignment with NAIC regulatory frameworks and actuarial standards of practice. This position will report to the Vice President Actuary (chief actuary? Actuarial practice lead?). It will not initially have supervisory responsibilities but such responsibilities can be expected with growth in the actuarial staff.

Responsibilities:

Technical

Regulatory Examination Leadership

  • Lead actuarial workstreams within financial condition examinations of life insurers conducted on behalf of state Departments of Insurance
  • Define scope, approach, and testing procedures for actuarial review areas
  • Develop defensible conclusions and support overall examination findings and recommendations

Statutory Valuation & Reserving Review

  • Evaluate adequacy of statutory reserves, including principle-based reserving (PBR) frameworks (VM-20, VM-21, VM-22 as applicable)
  • Review asset adequacy testing (AAT) and cash flow testing methodologies for compliance and reasonableness
  • Assess key assumptions (mortality, lapse, interest rates, expenses) and identify potential reserve deficiencies

Model, Assumption & Calculation Validation

  • Review actuarial models, including methodology, governance, and controls
  • Perform independent validation, benchmarking, or recalculation to corroborate company results
  • Assess data quality, assumption-setting processes, and model validation frameworks

Reinsurance & Complex Structures

  • Evaluate reinsurance arrangements (including captives and offshore structures) for risk transfer, reserve credit eligibility, and economic substance
  • Analyze the financial impact of reinsurance and capital optimization strategies

Policy Form and Rate Review

  • Analyze and evaluate life and A&H premium rate and policy form filing support documents, including nonforfeiture compliance for life insurance and annuity filings, loss ratio and related demonstrations of the reasonableness of A&H premiums, and compliance with other laws and regulations.
  • Evaluate actuarial justification of requests for significant rate increases.
  • Perform independent testing of ratemaking, nonforfeiture demonstration or other calculations, as needed.

General

  • Evaluate and leverage work of others, including CPAs, actuarial and risk management professionals, and internal auditors.
  • Provide support to the Examiner-in-Charge and the examination team related to actuarial process governance and controls.
  • Apply the Risk Focused approach in performing financial examinations.
  • Assist regulatory review of reinsurance contracts for compliance with risk transfer and related laws and statutory requirements.
  • Serve as a professional advisor and subject matter expert on technical matters of an actuarial nature.
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive reports containing findings, conclusions, and recommendations of an actuarial nature.
  • Perform other related duties as required.

Service clients

  • Exercise professionalism both on site and near the company.
  • Manage the expectations of the client, insurer, your supervisor and other team members.
  • Provide the client, insurer, and your supervisor with regular status updates.
  • Exhibit dynamic, flexible demeanor with superior client service skills.

Monitor and meet budgets

  • Assist in development of project budgets and proposals.
  • Manage timelines and budgets for actuarial procedures on assigned projects.
  • Provide supervisor advance notice when deliverables are near completion.

Ensure quality of work product

  • Coordinate actuarial support with non-actuarial project requirements.
  • Communicate the project objectives and responsibilities of actuarial team members.
  • Perform/review work completed in a timely manner.
  • Identify opportunities for improvements.
  • Identify and work towards resolution of potential issues.
  • Development and implement process efficiencies.
  • Assist other team members as needed.

Expand business and/or network

  • Ability to interact with all levels including executives and senior management.
  • Participate in networking meetings, lunches, and dinners.
  • Participate in NAIC, AAA and other regulatory development activities.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with key contacts.

Personal Development

  • Participate in performance reviews with Noble staff and project debriefing.
  • Ensure evaluations are received/administered as per Noble Consulting policy.
  • Complete basic and continuing education requirements in accordance with actuarial qualification standards
  • Maintain up to date knowledge of laws, regulations, actuarial guidelines, actuarial standards of practice and other guidance applicable to life and A&H actuarial practice.
  • Embrace opportunities to expand responsibility.
  • Share knowledge of actuarial best practices and actuarial standards of practice within the firm and the regulatory community.

Deliver conclusions and work product

  • Communicate proactively throughout engagements.
  • Provide conclusions in work performed, including summary memos of any findings.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in mathematics, actuarial science, statistics, economics, or other related business field.
  • 10+ years actuarial experience in a life insurance company, financial services or consulting firm, or regulatory agency in the United States, with strong emphasis on valuation and statutory reporting.
  • Designation of Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (or equivalent) and membership in the American Academy of Actuaries.
  • Demonstrated experience with regulatory examinations, financial audits, or consulting engagements supporting insurance regulators
  • Deep knowledge of statutory accounting principles (SAP), NAIC model regulations, and actuarial standards of practice (ASOPs)
  • Capable of leveraging past experience and expertise to adapt to current projects and challenges outside of core skill set.
  • Solid communication skills, both verbal and written. A commitment to the financial strength of the US insurance industry and the regulatory process to maintain that strength.

Preferred

  • Prior experience leading examination workstreams or managing client-facing regulatory engagements
  • Familiarity with reinsurance structures, including captives and reserve financing arrangements
  • Working knowledge of ERM/ORSA and insurer governance frameworks
  • PC skills including experience and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, TeamMate, ACL/Access, and other applications. Experience using life actuarial systems - MG-ALFA/Triton, Prophet, Axis, etc. – is a plus but is not required.

The position is open to remote/virtual work.

jobs.companyName: Atria Physician Practice New York PC
jobs.description:
The Atria Health Institute is a membership-based primary and specialty health care practice with a focus on prevention and longevity. We bring together a multidisciplinary team of renowned physicians to provide proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. All care, including primary care, advanced screening and diagnostics, urgent care, specialty care, 24/7 home visits, and imaging is included in members’ annual fee.

Our mission is to make healthspan and lifespan equal for all by translating science into medicine in real-time, all while bringing humanity back into health care. Delivering such robust, personalized, and preventive health care is complex and requires a team-wide dedication to excellence.

We have state-of-the-art facilities with imaging and diagnostics on-site in New York City, Palm Beach, and Los Angeles, with home services hubs in Miami, Greenwich/Westchester, and the Hamptons in summer. Additional locations are forthcoming in the Bay Area, Miami, and in downtown Manhattan. At each of our Institutes, we deliver personalized preventive medicine grounded in up-to-the-minute science — all in serene environments designed for trust and comfort.

About this role

As a Senior AI Engineer at Atria, you will own the design, development, and production deployment of the LLM-powered systems that put AI directly in front of clinicians and members: agentic medical companions, clinical decision support, and the document understanding pipelines that turn unstructured clinical data into usable signal. You'll work end-to-end across orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, and deployment, building on a data estate that very few organizations in the world can match (whole-genome sequencing, advanced imaging, longitudinal labs and wearables, multi-generational family records) and translating clinical and operational requirements into AI products that are reliable, safe, observable, and (crucially) actually used. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for an engineer who wants to do work with direct patient impact, and for whom "we'll add evals later" is the sort of phrase that ruins a perfectly good Tuesday.

What you'll do

• Architect and ship production AI systems end-to-end (orchestration, retrieval, inference, evaluation, and monitoring) for clinical decision support, document understanding, and agentic medical companions.

• Design agentic workflows with custom skills and harnesses, using frontier LLMs and self-hosted models where appropriate, and resisting the urge to reach for an agent when a function call would do.

• Lead development of structured information extraction pipelines from clinical documents, including automated verification systems and human-in-the-loop gates, where necessary.

• Build robust evaluation infrastructure (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression tests, online A/B evaluation) that gates every model and prompt change. Accuracy, safety, cost, and latency are first-class metrics.

• Engineer for latency and cost: streaming, caching, prompt compression, model routing, and inference-cost budgets.

• Own production health: trace- and span-level observability, prompt versioning, drift detection, cost monitoring, replay-from-production for debugging, PHI-safe logging throughout, and the general art of finding out something is broken before a clinician does.

• Operationalize models trained by the AI Scientist team: serving, evaluation in production, rollback paths, and the feedback loops that turn real usage into training and eval data, rather than into a Slack thread nobody reads.

• Partner with clinicians, the data engineering team, and our research collaborators to translate clinical requirements into specifications and deliverable systems.

• Educate and mentor PMs and engineers across Atria on applied AI best practices, from prompt and evaluation design to choosing the right model for the job (which, surprisingly often, is not the largest one).

Leadership and Influence

• Set technical direction for AI engineering at Atria: architecture decisions, build-vs-buy calls, and the evaluation and observability standards the team actually works to.

• Raise the bar on engineering practices, code review, observability, and incident response. Quietly, persistently, and with grace.

The Manager, Strategic Accounts owns a portfolio of strategic memberships, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts across the full membership lifecycle. RESPONSIBILITIES

Revenue & Growth

  • Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities by analyzing current account usage and business objectives.
  • Manage contract renewals and negotiate terms to maximize account lifetime value.
  • Track sales performance metrics and document strategic account plans within Salesforce.

Member Relationship & Strategy

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key members and decision-makers.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and strategy check-ins to ensure member goals are being met.

Member Onboarding, Contracts & Communication

  • Deal Execution & Contracting: Manage the end-to-end membership contract process—drafting tailored proposals and agreements—and coordinate closely with the finance team to oversee invoicing, billing accuracy, and accounts receivable tracking.
  • Relationship Management & Liaison: Serve as a professional, high touch point of contact for executive prospects and returning members, guiding them through negotiation, contract finalization, and the initial onboarding experience.
  • Strategic Communications: Draft and dispatch sophisticated, brand-aligned membership communications for both prospects and active accounts across all lines of business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Problem Solving

  • Coordinate with internal teams (Product, Member Success and Operations) to resolve member issues and deliver customized solutions.
  • Act as the voice of the members internally, sharing feedback to drive product or service improvements.
  • Track adoption and engagement data to proactively identify and mitigate retention risks.

Pipeline Management, Documentation & Forecasting

  • Salesforce & Knowledge Management: Maintain and optimize the business development pipelines in Salesforce and Box to ensure real-time accuracy, effective tracking against organizational growth goals, and reliable revenue forecasting.
  • Prospect Database Architecture: Build and curate highly targeted enterprise prospect lists within Salesforce across Health Evolution’s year-round experiences.
  • Meeting Intelligence & Follow-Up: Track and synthesize critical discussion outcomes from renewal meetings, managing immediate post-meeting execution items and ensuring key deliverables are tracked.
  • Weekly Communication Preparedness: Lead the weekly operational review of upcoming external touches, ensuring the renewals team is fully equipped with required documentation, historical member context, and finalized collateral ahead of external communications.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Membership Renewal: Achieve a strong annual membership renewal rate across the assigned account territory, meeting or exceeding established targets.
  • Pipeline Accuracy & Hygiene: Maintain zero-error tracking of all member leads, interaction notes, and pipeline stages within Salesforce and Box to ensure reliable leadership forecasting.
  • Contract Cycle Efficiency: Drive the end-to-end contracting and invoicing process to minimize delays between verbal agreement and signed, fully processed memberships.
  • Member Satisfaction & Onboarding: Deliver a high-touch, error-free onboarding communication experience for returning and new members, measured by prompt asset collection and seamless handoffs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES

  • Experience & Education: 3–5+ years in strategic account management, customer success, or membership/partnership management, preferably within health care or a professional membership organization; bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

  • Executive Communication Style: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft sophisticated, brand-aligned correspondence suitable for health care executives and enterprise members.
  • Operational Agility & Detail Orientation: Strong organizational habits with a track record of managing multiple contracting, scheduling, and documentation workflows simultaneously under tight timelines.
  • Event & Logistics Support: Ability to travel and provide high-energy, high-touch onsite operational support at premier, in-person executive leadership events.

YOUR CORPORATE SALARY HAS A CEILING. THIS DOESN'T.

The Hickman & Choate Agencies | SFG | Remote – U.S. Residents Only

You've spent years climbing the ladder — hitting quotas, managing accounts, sitting in traffic, logging miles, and building someone else's dream. You're good at what you do. Maybe great.

But somewhere along the way you started asking: Is this it?

What if you could apply everything you've already mastered — communication, relationship-building, discipline, professionalism — to something that actually scales with YOU?

──────────────────────────────
WHO THIS IS FOR
──────────────────────────────
This opportunity was built for people like:

🏢 Corporate professionals who want a flexible side income without quitting their day job — yet.

🚗 Road warriors, outside sales reps, and frequent travelers who already work independently and want their efforts building their own equity — not a company's.

📊 Business professionals, account managers, or project managers who are great with people but tired of income that's capped by a salary band.

🚪 Anyone quietly planning their exit from corporate life and looking for the right vehicle to make it happen on their terms.

You don't need to quit tomorrow. Many of our top agents started part-time and transitioned when the income replaced — then exceeded — their salary.

──────────────────────────────
WHAT YOU'LL DO
──────────────────────────────
Help American families protect their financial future with life insurance — using our proven system, our warm lead platform, and your natural ability to connect with people.

This isn't door-to-door. This isn't cold calling. Our award-winning tech platform delivers pre-interested prospects to you. You have conversations. You present solutions. You close. Virtually, on your schedule.

• Meet with warm, pre-qualified leads through our proprietary platform
• Conduct consultative needs-based conversations with families
• Present tailored life insurance solutions using our proven process
• Close policies and build a growing book of residual income
• Track your pipeline in our CRM (straightforward — you'll know it in a day)
• Scale into a leadership role and earn override income as you grow

──────────────────────────────
WHY THIS WORKS FOR BUSY PROFESSIONALS
──────────────────────────────
✅ 100% remote — your living room, a hotel room, a coffee shop. Wherever you are.
✅ Flexible hours — run it around your current schedule. Early mornings, evenings, weekends. You set it.
✅ No inventory, no overhead, no territory — just your phone, your laptop, and our system.
✅ Residual income — unlike commission jobs that reset to zero every month, life insurance policies renew. You get paid again and again on work you've already done.
✅ We cover half your licensing class — if you need a life insurance license, we invest in you first.
✅ Real training and mentorship — not a dumped-in-a-portal onboarding. Live coaching from producers actively writing business.

──────────────────────────────
WHAT YOU'LL EARN
──────────────────────────────
💰 This is 1099 / commission-only — meaning your income has no ceiling and no one else controls it.

• Starting out part-time: $1,000–$3,000/month supplemental income is very achievable
• Full-time first year following the system: $50,000–$120,000
• Experienced producers: $150,000–$400,000+
• Top leaders with teams: $750,000+
• Residual commissions that compound year over year

Results vary based on time invested, focus, and coachability. This is not a get-rich-quick scheme — it's a proven business model that rewards consistent professionals.

──────────────────────────────
YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE IN:
──────────────────────────────
→ Corporate sales, account management, or business development
→ Outside sales, territory management, or field sales
→ Financial services, banking, or wealth management
→ Real estate, mortgage, or insurance (any line)
→ Pharmaceutical, medical device, or B2B sales
→ Any role that required you to build relationships and manage a pipeline
→ Management consulting, HR, or operations — if you're a people person who gets results

You must be a U.S. resident currently authorized to work in the United States.

──────────────────────────────
LICENSING
──────────────────────────────
A life insurance license is required to sell — but you don't need one to apply. If you're not yet licensed, we cover 50% of your pre-licensing course cost and guide you through the process from start to finish. Most candidates complete licensing in 2–4 weeks.

──────────────────────────────
THE HONEST TRUTH
──────────────────────────────
This isn't for everyone. If you need a guaranteed paycheck, this isn't it. If you're not willing to follow a proven system, this isn't it. If you're outside the U.S., this isn't it.

But if you're a driven professional who is tired of your income being decided by someone else — and you're ready to bet on yourself — we'd love to talk.

──────────────────────────────
HOW TO APPLY
──────────────────────────────
No cover letter needed. Submit your resume and answer this one question:

"What does your ideal work-life look like in 3 years, and what's currently standing between you and that?"

Qualified applicants will be contacted within 48 hours to schedule a 20-minute discovery call.

jobs.title: General Interest Form
jobs.excerpt: Do you want to craft communications for the biggest names and brands, at a place that demands creativity and values the Oxford comma?
jobs.description:
Do you want to craft communications for the biggest names and brands, at a place that demands creativity and values the Oxford comma? If so, let us hear from you. We are always on the lookout for talented writers to join our team. If you do not see a specific position listed, you can submit a resume and writing samples for future consideration below. If we're interested in your application, a member of our recruitment committee may reach out for a chat to get to know you, even if we aren't currently hiring.

West Wing Writers is a strategic communications firm with offices in Washington, DC and New York City, as well as employees located across the country. We’re veterans of the Obama White House and the Clinton White House, of presidential campaigns, governors’ offices, and Capitol Hill. We’re journalists and teachers; novelists and activists; comedians, poets, and foreign policy experts.

Today, we craft messaging for some of the most compelling leaders and thinkers. We’ve helped CEOs tell their stories on the world’s biggest stages. We’ve helped global foundations make the case for a new wave of philanthropy. We’ve helped politicians rally national political conventions, companies launch products to global markets, and people from all walks of life hold TED audiences in rapt attention.

Every day we come to work, we partner with a wide array of clients around the world—from Fortune 500 Companies to progressive activists—to find their voice, hone their message, and push for change. We love what we do, and we’d love you to join us.

‍We’re committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented groups to reach out, including people of color, women, LGBTQ+ individuals, gender-nonconforming people, neurodivergent individuals, veterans, individuals with disabilities, and multilingual individuals.

Requirements

Although we aren’t currently hiring, we look to our candidate pool first whenever we need a new employee. No matter their level of experience, all of our candidates should have:

  • Extensive research experience
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills
  • The ability to work with clients of different backgrounds and styles, who request a variety of deliverables
  • Interest and experience in writing and communications
  • The skills to craft compelling, original prose, while balancing client goals and internal guidance; and
  • The ability to accept, internalize, and implement feedback

Generally, we hire at two levels, depending on our needs and the candidate’s experience and abilities: Associate and Director. We also conduct a robust internship program available to all, three times a year.

  • Interns: 0+ years of experience, $3,300 monthly, please see our website for more information on how to apply;
  • Associates: 0+ years of relevant experience, salary range of $65,000 - $86,300; and
  • Directors: 6+ years of relevant experience, salary range of $92,500 - $125,000.

Due to the amount of interest we receive we will not be able to respond to every request. We suggest that you update your application in our system annually if you are still interested in working with us.

Benefits

Benefits include full employee health, dental, vision, and life insurance paid for by West Wing Writers, with 25% of dependents' premiums covered. All employees earn 15-20 days of vacation leave, 10 sick days, 2 floating holidays, 2 volunteer days, and 12 paid holidays off every year. We also have a robust medical leave and paid parental leave policy.

As of 2023, West Wing Writers became employee-owned when we implemented an Employee Ownership Stock Plan (ESOP). This transfer of ownership reflects our people-centered values and culture and our mission to enhance our team-driven, outcome-oriented approach. Every year, employee-owners receive shares of our stock on top of a 3% safe harbor 401(k) contribution.

Pre-Sales Architect – Cloud

Job Description:

We are seeking a Pre-Sales Architect to join our Cloud team. The ideal candidate will have experience in technical pre-sales, solution architecture, consulting, and enablement, with a focus on cloud services, primarily Microsoft Azure, and Modern Workplace, optional exposure to AWS is plus.
This role is crucial for driving business growth through strategic technical engagements within our Microsoft Partners, with a strong focus on developing relationships with our Partners to support the Partner Development Managers to drive sales execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate the resellers and their customer needs, drive sales execution, and develop opportunities for both Net New and Existing Customers.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, vendors, and regional staff across all Vertical markets.
  • Define and monitor performance metrics for vendors’ products and services.
  • Conduct regular meetings (both online and face-to-face) with partners to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions.
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of technical pre-sales and solution architecture to solve complex problems using innovative solutions while working independently with minimal guidance.
  • Contribute towards building technical awareness of new products within our reseller community, through Planning Technical Road Map, Workshops, Webinars and Events.
  • Contribute to the management of processes and process improvements and provide informal guidance to junior colleagues.
  • Provide training and support to partners to enhance their knowledge of our products and services.
  • Contribute to the overall Revenue/Profitability of the business through initiatives and activity designed to deliver financial performance
  • Additional Pre-Sales activities and initiatives as the business requires

Cultural Values:

  • Creativity: Innovate and think outside the box to provide unique solutions.
  • Loyalty: Build and maintain strong, loyal relationships with partners.
  • Ownership: Take responsibility for your work and drive initiatives to completion.
  • Unity: Collaborate effectively with team members to achieve common goals.
  • Dedication: Show commitment and dedication to your role and the success of the team.

Who we are looking for:

  • Experience in technical pre-sales, solution architecture, consulting, and enablement.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud services, primarily Microsoft Azure & Microsoft Modern Workplace
  • Broader Knowledge of Microsoft Cloud and Hybrid Solutions and Cloud Security, or AWS, Marketplace, Partner Centre, or aligned vendor programmes and incentives.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Licensing
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

What we offer:

  • Competitive compensation (base + variable).

  • Private healthcare and other benefits.

Equal Opportunity:
