jobs.title: UCaaS & Critical Communications Sales – SLED Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven SLED Account Manager to expand ITMC's presence across Arizona, Texas, Florida, and other strategic remote markets.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven SLED Account Manager to expand ITMC's presence across Arizona, Texas, Florida, and other strategic remote markets. This is a high-impact sales role focused on developing new business opportunities and growing long-term relationships within State, Local Government, Education (SLED), Healthcare, and Public Sector organizations.

This is not a transactional telecom sales position. We are looking for a consultative sales professional with a proven track record of selling UCaaS, CCaaS, VoIP, networking, cybersecurity, or managed technology solutions into complex organizations. The ideal candidate understands public sector procurement, RFP processes, cooperative purchasing contracts, and the importance of building trusted, long-term customer relationships.

Success in this role requires a strategic hunter who can identify opportunities, lead executive-level conversations, navigate complex sales cycles, and position ITMC as a trusted technology partner.

What You'll Sell

  • 101VOICE UCaaS, Hosted PBX, SIP Trunking, and VoIP solutions
  • Microsoft Teams Voice and collaboration solutions
  • CCaaS and AI-powered contact center platforms
  • Enterprise networking, wireless, and cybersecurity solutions
  • Professional and managed IT services
  • ARVOS Push-to-Talk (PoC) solutions for education, healthcare, transportation, government, and public safety organizations

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a territory growth strategy focused on SLED, Healthcare, and Public Sector organizations.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
  • Build trusted relationships with CIOs, IT Directors, Superintendents, municipal leaders, procurement teams, and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through solution design, proposal development, contract negotiation, and close.
  • Conduct executive presentations, customer demonstrations, and business reviews.
  • Collaborate with engineering, solution architects, project management, and leadership to develop customer solutions.
  • Navigate public sector procurement processes, including RFPs, RFIs, cooperative purchasing agreements, and contract vehicles.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM documentation.
  • Represent ITMC at industry conferences, customer events, and regional networking opportunities.
  • Develop long-term strategic accounts by identifying expansion opportunities and serving as a trusted advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.

• 5+ years of telecom, UCaaS, or cloud communication sales experience
• Proven experience selling into State, Local Government, Education, or Healthcare
• Demonstrated ability to generate and close net-new business
• Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles
• Strong understanding of public sector buying processes
• Track record of meeting or exceeding quota

Preferred Experience

• Background working with a telecom service provider, CLEC, or UCaaS company
• Experience with public sector contracts, cooperatives, or framework agreements
• Knowledge of E-Rate, CTF, or public funding models
• Familiarity with MEDDICC, Challenger, or similar methodologies
• Strong territory planning and account development skills
• Experience selling critical communication or mobility solutions
• Existing relationships in the SLED ecosystem

Why Join Us

• Award-winning, fast-growing company with national reach
• Strong reputation in education and government markets
• Differentiated portfolio including AI and mission-critical communications
• Entrepreneurial culture with leadership access
• Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
• Ability to make a real impact in communities and public institutions

If you are passionate about helping public organizations modernize communication and want to work with a company known for reliability, innovation, and execution, we invite you to apply.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

UCaaS & Critical Communications Sales – SLED Account Manager (101VOICE & ARVOS Push-to-Talk)

Location: Arizona, Texas, Florida & Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

Company Overview

IT Management Corporation (ITMC), dba 101VOICE, is a leading provider of Unified Communications, Contact Center, Networking, Security, and Critical Communications solutions serving State, Local Government, Education (SLED), Healthcare, and other public sector organizations across the United States.

Since 2009, ITMC has helped organizations modernize their communications and IT infrastructure through secure, scalable, and resilient technology solutions. As a trusted advisor, we partner with our customers to design, deploy, and support mission-critical environments that improve collaboration, reliability, and operational efficiency.

Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list four times and featured multiple times on CRN's Solution Provider rankings, ITMC has built a reputation for technical expertise, exceptional customer service, and long-term partnerships.

Our portfolio includes:

  • 101VOICE – Cloud-based UCaaS, CCaaS, Microsoft Teams Voice, AI-powered communications, and collaboration solutions.
  • ARVOS Push-to-Talk – Nationwide Push-to-Talk over Cellular (PoC) solutions providing instant, secure communication for transportation, utilities, education, healthcare, public safety, and enterprise organizations.
  • Enterprise networking, wireless infrastructure, cybersecurity, and professional services from leading technology partners.

At ITMC, our mission is simple: Deliver secure, reliable technology solutions that keep organizations connected when communication matters mos

jobs.title: Senior Managing Consultant - Business Strategy/AI Advisor
jobs.excerpt: As a Senior Business Strategy & AI Advisor, you will lead a cross-functional team in the delivery of Advisory offerings in Business Strategy and AI, Business Strategy, and Business Advisory Services.
jobs.description:
As a Senior Business Strategy & AI Advisor, you will lead a cross-functional team in the delivery of Advisory offerings in Business Strategy and AI, Business Strategy, and Business Advisory Services.

You will partner with clients to shape and execute strategies that leverage AI technologies and innovative approaches for measurable business outcomes, ensuring responsible, scalable, and human-centric adoption as well as overall business readiness and enablement.

This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and implementation value, innovation, and organizational preparedness for transformation—leading clients and internal teams through ambiguity into clarity and value. You will provide strategic leadership to ensure that decision-making aligns to long term objectives for realized value as the trusted advisor for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Advise clients on business strategy, including leadership alignment, policies and procedures, governance, Centers of Excellence, process evaluation, and organizational design/development.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the AI Advisory vision and roadmap, aligning offerings and methods with Advisory leadership.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, guiding organizations from AI readiness assessment through enterprise-scale adoption.
  • Position Advisory as the strategic entry point for AI engagements, connecting business objectives, KPIs, and transformation outcomes.

Offerings & IP Development

  • Deliver and support continued development of Business Advisory offerings and cross-discipline offerings within the Advisory subdomain.
  • Contribute to the continued development of repeatable AI Advisory offerings (AI Starter, AI Value Accelerator, Copilot Readiness, Governance frameworks, etc.).
  • Create frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks that integrate AI maturity models (Microsoft, NIST, Google, Ng) and Responsible AI practices.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Advisory’s portfolio through thought leadership, case studies, and market insights.

Client Engagement & Outcomes

  • Facilitate engaging conversations, workshops, and interviews for meaningful discovery that lead to insights, business intelligence, and recommendations.
  • Lead C-suite workshops, envisioning sessions, and transformation roadmaps, translating AI into measurable business value.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (UX, data, technical, change management) to deliver holistic, human-centered solutions.
  • Ensure delivery of measurable value, operational efficiency, and sustainable adoption for clients.

Capability Building

  • Mentor Advisory consultants in AI fluency, client strategy, and facilitation skills.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and upskilling the Advisory team to strengthen our AI bench.
  • Actively contribute to internal AI Center of Excellence (COE) and cross-practice enablement.
  • Business Strategy & Advisory: Proven experience in business strategy, value realization, and technology-enabled transformation.
  • AI & Data Expertise: Understanding of AI governance, generative AI, Copilot/LLM ecosystems, data maturity, and RAG architectures.
  • Technology Awareness: Familiarity with Microsoft platforms (Azure, M365 Copilot, D365, Power Platform, Fabric/Databricks).
  • Workshop Facilitation: Skilled in strategic roadmapping, design thinking, and executive-level facilitation.
  • Change Leadership: Ability to drive adoption, manage risk, and embed responsible, ethical AI practices.
  • Human-Centric Leadership: High EQ, creativity, and a passion for building high-performing, future-ready teams.

Education, Certifications & Background

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Microsoft AI-900 (required); AI-102 (preferred).
  • PROSCI or equivalent change management certification (preferred)
  • 10+ years of experience in business strategy, advisory, or consulting, with a focus on AI, analytics, or digital transformation.
  • Track record of executive engagement and trusted advisor relationships at senior levels.

Why This Role, Why Now

Clients are demanding clarity and confidence in their AI journeys. Hitachi has the technology stack and delivery capability—what’s needed is a dedicated leader within Advisory to align strategy, value, and adoption.

In addition, as the business landscape changes, leaders feel less confident in their ability to lean on past knowledge to innovate their business. They are looking for wisdom and guidance to prepare their organizations for what is coming. They need strategic advisors who are ready to move beyond best practices to create innovative and customized recommendations for the road ahead.

By appointing a Business & AI Advisory Lead, we establish a focal point for client trust, internal capability, and market differentiation, ensuring Advisory is positioned at the heart of AI-enabled transformation

Base Salary Pay Range*: $125,000 - $190,000 USD/$125,000 - $175,000 CAD

*The current applicable Base Salary Pay Range for this role is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills relevant to the role, internal equity, alignment with market data, or other law.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

NOTE: WHILE THIS ROLE IS REMOTE, YOU MUST BE A US CITIZEN OR ABLE TO WORK WITHIN THE UNITED STATES OR CANADA WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP.

Other Compensation / Benefit Overview

In addition to Base Salary, the successful candidate may be eligible to participate in the following plans / programs, upon satisfying all hiring requirements:

  • Bonus Plan
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
  • Life Insurance and Disability Programs
  • Retirement Savings with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Work Arrangements including Remote Work

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

Beware of scams

Our recruiting team may communicate with candidates via our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address and/or via our SmartRecruiters (Applicant Tracking System) domain email address regarding your application and interview requests.

All offers will originate from our @hitachisolutions.com domain email address. If you receive an offer or information from someone purporting to be an employee of Hitachi Solutions from any other domain, it may not be legitimate.

Hitachi Solutions is a global Microsoft solutions integrator passionate about developing and delivering industry-focused solutions that support our clients to deliver on their business transformation goals. Our industry focus, expertise, and intellectual property is what truly sets us apart. We have earned, and continue to maintain, a strategic relationship with Microsoft. Recognized for our achievements - teaming with our clients to deliver innovative digital solutions and services - is how we have achieved year after year recognition.

As their trusted advisor, we support our clients to deliver on their strategic business initiatives as they unify, automate, and modernize their data and operations to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance their customer’s experience. Our over 3,000 team members across 14 countries, and our 18 years of 100% focus on Microsoft technologies and business applications, is how we deliver excellence through expert services and industry-focused cloud solutions.

A part of Hitachi, Ltd., our company has a long and rich history of innovation, financial strength, and international presence of one of the world’s largest companies. Since 1910, Hitachi, Ltd. has been a leader in manufacturing innovative products and solutions that support industry and social infrastructure around the globe supported by 303,000 employees in over 100 countries and across 864 companies.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Managing Director to lead one of our software businesses within TAG Software Group. As MD, you will own the P&L, set strategic direction, and drive sustained growth and profitability across the business.

Success will be measured by outcomes, raising operational excellence, scaling customer success, and building high-performing leadership teams that multiply impact. This position provides critical operational leadership to a company and potentially a portfolio of companies within a growing software vertical.

ABOUT TAG SOFTWARE GROUP:

TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.

Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.

Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology including and — helping your business reach the next level.

INVESTMENT APPROACH:

Unlike private equity and venture capital firms, we are Entrepreneurs who Buy, Enhance and Grow Software Businesses. That’s right; we don’t sell businesses. We form a strategic alliance with existing management teams. We recognize the dedication and perseverance required to create a firm and place a premium on customers’ and workers’ well-being over short-term goals.

CULTURE:

Tag Software Group is more than just a place to work; we’re a team. We mean it when we say people are our greatest assets, so investing in them is our number one priority. We create an environment where our employees feel first-day-on-the-job excitement, day after day, creating a culture of high performers and collaboration. We celebrate our milestones, and we’re proud of them. We Dream Big, Stay Humble, and Stay Hungry.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

As Managing Director, you will provide strategic, operational, and financial leadership to a software business or portfolio within the Tag Software Group family. You will develop and implement the business strategy across sales, marketing, R&D, customer service, professional services, and HR. Working with the Business Unit leadership team, you will set growth objectives, lead execution, and drive operational excellence.

You will be fully accountable for business performance, profitability, scalability, and long-term customer and employee success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Achieve sustainable business growth by positioning the company strategically within its markets and aligning operations with long-term objectives.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in scalability, efficiency, and operational excellence across the business.
  • Drive consistent revenue growth through effective market expansion, cross-selling, and customer-focused strategies.
  • Ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty remain strong, supporting high retention and advocacy.
  • Maintain clear, market-aligned product strategies and roadmaps that balance innovation with stability, supporting both new customer acquisition and retention.
  • Foster an environment of innovation and technology adoption, challenging the status quo and leveraging emerging tools (including AI) to improve products, services, and operations.
  • Own full P&L responsibility, ensuring revenue growth, profitability, financial discipline, and long-term resilience.
  • Translate deep financial insight into strategic and operational decisions that maximize value creation.
  • Meet or exceed key performance metrics including revenue, EBITDA, ROI, and customer retention.
  • Optimize capital allocation and ensure predictable financial performance across monthly, quarterly, and annual periods.
  • Build and sustain high-performing teams capable of delivering exceptional results across all functions.
  • Create a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement that enhances both individual and organizational performance.
  • Inspire, motivate, and develop teams to achieve ambitious milestones and exceed expectations.
  • Lead confidently through change, simplifying complexity, removing roadblocks, and executing strategies that deliver long-term business success.
  • Represent Tag Software Group leadership values by demonstrating humility, empathy, strategic judgment, and an entrepreneurial mindset in all decisions.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proven ability to own a P&L and deliver sustained growth, profitability, and scalability.
  • Track record of driving market expansion, launching new products, or transforming businesses.
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to make value-creating decisions.
  • Experience building and leading executive-level teams.
  • Comfort with emerging technologies (including AI).
  • Exceptional communication and influence skills.
  • Ability to simplify complexity, work through ambiguity, and make bold decisions.
  • Resilience and adaptability under pressure.

ADDITIONAL OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Prior experience managing a B2B software company.
  • Proven entrepreneurial mindset and pace-setter traits.
  • Bachelor’s degree (MBA or advanced degree a plus).
  • 8+ years of cross-functional leadership experience with P&L ownership.
  • Broad financial understanding (P&L, BI tools, FP&A, financial documents).
  • Experience developing strategies for customer acquisition and market penetration.
  • Ability to analyze and solve complex business problems.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

WHY JOIN US:

  • Lead an established software company with the backing of a global acquisition group.
  • High autonomy within a decentralized operating structure.
  • Opportunity to shape and scale a business for long-term success.
  • Career growth within a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial ecosystem.

jobs.title: Senior Data Governance Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Data Governance Manager is a strategic leader within Catalight’s Enterprise Data & Analytics organization, responsible for establishing, operationalizing, and maturing enterprise-wide data governance capabilities across the organization’s healthcare, analytics, and AI/ML ecosystems.
jobs.description:
The Senior Data Governance Manager is a strategic leader within Catalight’s Enterprise Data & Analytics organization, responsible for establishing, operationalizing, and maturing enterprise-wide data governance capabilities across the organization’s healthcare, analytics, and AI/ML ecosystems. Reporting to the Director of Data & Analytics, this role serves as the primary authority for data governance, data stewardship, metadata management, data quality, and regulatory compliance related to HIPAA, PII, and PHI. This role works closely with the Senior Data Architect, Senior Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Business Intelligence Analysts, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data assets are secure, compliant, trustworthy, well-documented, and appropriately governed for operational reporting, analytics, and AI/ML initiatives.

Enterprise Data Governance Leadership

  • Establish, lead, and continuously mature Catalight’s enterprise data governance program, policies, standards, and operating model
  • Define governance frameworks for data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, access management, retention, and lifecycle management
  • Develop governance roadmaps and maturity strategies aligned with Catalight’s analytics, AI/ML, and data democratization objectives
  • Establish governance councils, stewardship programs, and cross-functional governance processes across business and technical teams
  • Define and maintain enterprise standards for governed data usage across analytics and AI/ML workloads

HIPAA, PII PHI Compliance

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for HIPAA, PHI, PII, and healthcare data governance requirements within the Data & Analytics organization
  • Define and enforce data classification, handling, retention, masking, and access control standards for sensitive healthcare data
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, Legal, and Technology teams to ensure data governance practices align with regulatory and organizational requirements
  • Support audit readiness, compliance reporting, risk assessments, and remediation efforts related to healthcare and regulated data
  • Establish governance controls to ensure appropriate segregation and protection of sensitive and non-sensitive analytical environments

Snowflake Governance & Data Platform Stewardship

  • Lead governance strategy and standards for Catalight’s Snowflake data platform
  • Define and maintain governance standards for Snowflake object naming, role-based access controls (RBAC), data sharing, metadata management, and data lifecycle processes
  • Partner with the Senior Data Architect and Senior Data Engineer to ensure governance controls are operationalized within Snowflake pipelines, data models, and access patterns
  • Support implementation and governance of medallion architecture, semantic layers, curated data products, and governed self-service analytics capabilities
  • Monitor and improve data quality, consistency, lineage, and usability across enterprise Snowflake environments

Metadata, Lineage & Data Stewardship

  • Establish and maintain enterprise metadata standards, business glossaries, data dictionaries, and lineage documentation
  • Define stewardship responsibilities and partner with business stakeholders to improve data ownership and accountability
  • Enable governed self-service analytics and data discovery through standardized metadata and cataloging practices
  • Drive enterprise adoption of data stewardship and governance best practices across technical and non-technical teams

AI/ML Governance & Emerging Technology Enablement

  • Metadata, Lineage & Data Stewardship
  • Establish and maintain enterprise metadata standards, business glossaries, data dictionaries, and lineage documentation
  • Define stewardship responsibilities and partner with business stakeholders to improve data ownership and accountability
  • Enable governed self-service analytics and data discovery through standardized metadata and cataloging practices
  • Drive enterprise adoption of data stewardship and governance best practices across technical and non-technical teams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with the Senior Data Architect to align governance policies with enterprise data architecture standards
  • Collaborate with the Senior Data Engineer to operationalize governance controls, monitoring, and quality validation within data pipelines
  • Work closely with BI Analysts and business stakeholders to improve trust, usability, and consistency of enterprise reporting assets
  • Communicate governance standards, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Contribute to enterprise analytics strategy, roadmap planning, and organizational data maturity initiatives

Program Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Define governance KPIs, maturity metrics, and adoption measurements
  • Lead governance-related training, documentation, and organizational change management initiatives
  • Establish repeatable governance workflows and operational processes that scale with organizational growth
  • Continuously evaluate and improve governance practices, tooling, and operational effectiveness

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field preferred; or 8+ years of relevant experience in data governance, data management, analytics governance, or related disciplines in lieu of a degree
  • Demonstrated experience leading or implementing enterprise data governance programs in regulated environments
  • Strong expertise in HIPAA, PHI, PII, healthcare data privacy, and data compliance practices
  • Hands-on experience governing cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake
  • Strong understanding of metadata management, data lineage, stewardship models, and data quality frameworks
  • Experience supporting governance for analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML ecosystems
  • Familiarity with governance and cataloging platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview, or similar tools preferred
  • Strong SQL and analytical data literacy skills
  • Experience collaborating with technical engineering teams and business stakeholders in cross-functional environments
  • Experience supporting healthcare, behavioral health, payer/provider, or regulated healthcare ecosystems preferred

Requests:

  • Must be able to communicate effectively within the work environment, read and write using the primary language within the workplace.
  • Visual and auditory ability to work with clients, staff and others in the workplace continuously.
  • Frequent speaking and listening (25-75%) to clients, staff, and others in the workplace.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (organized by our company values):

  • Seeks to understand the underlying needs, desires, and values of colleagues.
  • Proactively builds spaces for others to engage in learning and community.
  • Appreciates and demonstrates collaboration across teams.
  • Serves as a role model, bringing our core values to life in your work.
  • Work in an exciting, fast paced high energy environment while effectively multitasking and managing day-to-day responsibilities without supervision.
  • Personable; able to work comfortably with individuals at all levels within the organization.
  • Excellent verbal and writing communication skills; frequent proofreading and checking documents for accuracy.

Equity informed:

  • Knowledge of multiple historically excluded groups with knowledge in I/DD (intellectual and developmental disability) communities.
  • Interest in working with and elevating employee needs.
  • Approaches work with a growth mindset, welcome feedback, and understand that humans all have biases and are imperfect as a baseline.
  • Experience working and communicating with families.
  • Sensitivity to working with an ethnically, linguistically, culturally, and economically diverse population.

Bold:

  • Navigates ambiguity with an excitement for problem solving.
  • Effectively manages programs from visioning to implementation + impact measure.
  • Commitment to meet agreed upon deadlines on time or ahead of schedule.
  • Transparent on action, pursuits, and outcomes.
  • A commitment to the values of the organization while demonstrating good judgment, flexibility, patience and discretion when dealing with confidential and sensitive matters.

Wellbeing driven:

  • Willingness and commitment to self-reflection and re-thinking.

Conditions of Employment

Job Title: Director, Public Health
Location: Remote; ideally located in NY, NJ, PA, MD, or VA

Description

Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not. We take pride in having multi-year, multi-project engagements, often working closely as an extension of their staff. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.

Position Overview

The Director, Public Health (DoPH) leads our US-based Public Health initiatives to improve population health by applying novel processes, project management strategies, and data science tools to build effective solutions to complex public health problems. The DoPH will manage a team of Public Health consultants to inform policy, system, and environmental changes aimed at improving the health status of state and local public health programs through a health equity framework. Additionally, the DoPH will directly manage key client engagements and key relationships to liaise between clients, community agencies, institutions, providers, coalitions and our internal BME Strategies team to fulfill the goals of our firm; finally the DoPH will serve on BME’s on leadership team to contribute to the overall firm strategy, direction, and leadership. The Ideal candidate for this role has direct experience working in local public health in one of the following states: NY, NJ, PA, MD, VA.

Key Responsibilities

BME Org-Wide Responsibilities for Directors:

  • Serves as strategic and technical advisor.
  • Manages organizational stewardship; high-level and/or strategic accounts, and provides practice/service leadership.
  • Supervises leadership with a minimal assignment
  • Establishes and accountable to growth strategy and targets.
  • Approval/sign off on all proposals prior to submission.
  • Support leadership and management in proposal and pitch strategy.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Along with the Managing Director and Leadership Team, develops the strategic direction and priorities of BME Strategies to produce and oversee work plans and future project pipelines.
  • Manages and mentors Practice Leads, as well as individual consultants servicing client programs, in Business Development, KPIs, reporting staff support, and management.
  • Informs the firm’s work through a health equity lens to actively engage in working towards eliminating health disparities.
  • Provides assistance to the Executive Team/Managing Director of BME Strategies in carrying out the core functions of the firm, i.e., the design and implementation of public health programs, conducting new business development, and improving client services.
  • In coordination with the Director, Business Development, leads and/or provides oversight of the preparation of project and grant proposals and applications and manages the completion of project and grant deliverables.
  • Directs research development, collection, and analysis of data sets for monitoring, evaluation and program implementation.
  • Oversees the development of reports that detail the conclusions developed from BME projects and identifies solutions, as well as opportunities for improvement within the field using data trends.
  • Assists in the preparation of data, results, and journal submissions for publication.
  • Communicates effectively and collaborates with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Leads performance management and quality improvement related to the client programs and internal BME services.

Experience, Qualification, & Skills

  • Minimum 10 years relevant experience required.
    • Required areas of experience and expertise: project management, data analysis, Public Health and strategy consulting, grant sourcing and management.
    • Experience working in local public health in one of the following states: NY, NJ, PA, MD, VA.
  • Minimum of 6 years day-to-day people management experience, including leading teams toward complex Public Health interventions.
  • Minimum of 6 years in practice/service area leadership.
  • Master’s degree in Public Health or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years client-facing experience, including 7 or more in project leadership roles.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
  • Proven track record of balancing personnel management with individual work product across multiple tasks with excellent organization skills and attention to detail.
  • Collaborative and supportive working style with the ability to interact positively across a variety of team members, clients and stakeholders.
  • And an alignment with BME’s shared values.

Work Environment

  • This is a full-time position based in a home office environment within the U.S; NY, NJ, PA, MD, or VA preferred.
  • BME Strategies in a remote-first organization. This role may require occasional travel to client sites, conferences, or meetings as required; 10-15% of travel is anticipated for this role.

Compensation & Benefits

  • BME Strategies offers a competitive compensation package that includes:
    • 6+ weeks total leave, including paid vacation, sick time, personal leave, and floating holidays;
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with 75% employer-paid coverage for the employee & 50% employer-paid coverage for dependents;
    • Health FSA and dependent care FSA;
    • 401(k) with employer match;
    • Employer-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance;
    • One-time technology stipend;
    • And opportunities for professional development and career growth.

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

Position: Senior Electrical Engineer

Salary $120K - $160K

Above Group Overview

We offer you the opportunity to put your passion and your God given talents and abilities to use. Our goal is to attract and develop skilled, called, and passionate people to impact our devoted customers and our team. For more information, see www.abovegroupinc.com.

Our People Strategy

We believe in a people strategy to be the fundamental driver of our organization. While we can never reach a perfect organizational model, we can certainly strive towards it in our daily efforts and mission. With that vision comes a focus of key initiatives we are working on, listed here, with the indicators of what it should look like as we approach:

  • Shared Direction: A collective understanding of what the organization stands for, where it is going, and how we will get there. Indicators: a clear inspiring vision, well-executed strategies, clear aligned goals.

  • Productive Relationships: Open, collaborative relationships that recognize and honor the commitments that people make to themselves, each other, their work, and the organization. Indicators: respect for all individuals, effective problem solving and decision-making, clear accountability, effective teamwork at all levels.
  • Liberating Processes: Flexible structures, processes, and technologies that allow people to do their best work and to collaborate effectively across boundaries. Indicators: clear organizational design, collective knowledge, the right tools and technologies, the right people for the right jobs.
  • Outcome Learning: Results-focused learning that strengthens individual and organizational capacity to cope with the present and define the future. Indicators: continuous teaching and learning, effective knowledge and skills development, leadership development at all levels.
  • Motivating Metrics: Fair, meaningful performance requirements, measures and rewards that reinforce high performance and manage poor performance. Indicators: clear and energizing performance requirements, relevant work measures, differentiated rewards.

Our Vision – What We Want to Do

Continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God.

Our Mission – Why We Exist

Demonstrating the love of Jesus Christ through empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service.

Our Values – How We Will Accomplish This Mission

Our Core Values are the tools we use and the behaviors we exhibit as Employees of Above Group. They describe how we work together to achieve this special place we’re developing and how they make us uniquely successful.

  • Christian Values - We demonstrate humility, honesty, integrity, respect, kindness, and a sense of social responsibility.
  • Uncompromising Quality – We provide excellent results all the time, every time.
  • Buffalo – We take initiative running toward and owning challenges.
  • Extreme Team – We are accountable to each other to continuously grow and succeed.

Senior Electrical Engineer

The Position

The Senior Electrical Engineer for Above Group performs and provides engineering services for design and construction of projects along with delegating tasks to complete the designs of each project for the Firm. The Senior Electrical Engineer shall possess a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent, from an ABET accredited institution. This individual shall directly contribute to the Firm and its success through the application of knowledge and technical experience to effectively produce a quality design and ultimate product to the customer. The Senior Electrical Engineer is also responsible for contributing to the growth of the team by leading and mentoring subordinate staff in expanding their capabilities and contributions.

General Duties

  • Responsible for the technical quality of the design of all projects to which they are assigned.
  • Responsible for the on-time delivery of all deliverables, which meet AG submission requirements for all projects to which they are assigned. This includes completion of QA/QC process.
  • Delegate tasks and assignments across projects to meet deadlines and coordinate staffing efficiently. This will be done using AG’s planning system, Team Gantt. Coordinate design elements with other disciplines.
  • Facilitate and engage with new clients in support of business development activities, as requested.
  • Interface with clients to ensure their needs and requirements for projects are met.
  • Review shop drawing submittals and ensure compliance with contract documents.
  • Perform site investigations to ensure the project is being executed to proper standard and expectations of the company and clients’ needs and desires.
  • Ensure compliance and safety standards are met.
  • Be able to resolve problems utilizing engineering principles.
  • Provide mentorship towards new onboarding designers and jr. engineers.
  • Meet with respective co-workers weekly, bi-weekly and monthly to stay up to date on project changes and requests.
  • Provide a clear line of communication across projects and engineering departments.
  • Maintain proper documentation of project information using Newforma Konekt.
  • Conduct peer review and editing on projects for proper approval, as needed.
  • Ensure the submission of timesheets for employees under your supervision.
  • Contribute to the development of company-wide standards and processes.
  • Maintain current knowledge of codes, standards and local regulations
  • Collaborate with marketing department for proper production of projects.
  • Metrics for the team include, but are not limited to: utilization rate, QA/QC completion
  • Conduct site analysis surveys.
  • See projects through from contract and proposals to end results.
  • Manage department workload prioritization.
  • Implement and design systems that meet the standards of clients contracted through Above Group.
  • Attend meetings with corresponding departments that are integral to current and ongoing projects.
  • Provide life safety analysis and review of design submittals.
  • Provides supervision to Staff Engineers, Engineers, and Designers assigned to their team (1-3 direct reports + 1-4 indirect reports).

Key Characteristics of the Ideal Senior Electrical Engineer

jobs.excerpt: Role SummaryWe are seeking a hands-on business leader to operate and scale a B2B SaaS business unit serving the clinical trial space.
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a hands-on business leader to operate and scale a B2B SaaS business unit serving the clinical trial space. This role combines full P&L ownership with responsibility for operational excellence, customer delivery, organizational effectiveness, and AI-driven transformation.

The successful candidate is an operator first. They have built and improved systems, streamlined organizations, implemented automation, and driven measurable business outcomes. They are comfortable moving between executive-level decision-making and detailed operational execution.

This leader will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Finance to improve business performance while building a more scalable, AI-enabled operating model.

What You'll Own

Business Performance

  • Own business unit financial performance, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs, and profitability.
  • Develop and execute operating plans that balance customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
  • Refine performance metrics and accountability across functions.

AI & Operational Transformation

  • Lead the adoption of AI and automation across customer-facing and internal workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, reduce organizational complexity, and increase productivity. • Champion an AI-first mindset across teams.
  • Establish measurable targets for productivity gains and operational leverage.

Customer Delivery & Operations

  • Improve delivery quality, utilization, scalability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Build repeatable processes that reduce dependency on individual contributors.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data, process redesign, and technology.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Align Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Operations around common business goals.
  • Translate strategic priorities into operational execution.
  • Remove bottlenecks and improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Lead business reviews and operating cadences.

Team Development

  • Build high-accountability teams focused on outcomes.
  • Coach managers and develop future leaders.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, continuous improvement, and experimentation.

What Success Looks Like

Within 12 months, this leader will have:

  • Increased organizational productivity through AI and automation initiatives.
  • Simplified operating processes and reduced complexity across the business.
  • Improved gross margin and operating efficiency.
  • Increased customer retention and delivery effectiveness.
  • Established a scalable operating model capable of supporting future growth.
  • Built a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.

This posting is for an existing, open vacancy. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help screen, assess, and/or select applicants during our hiring process; final decisions are reviewed by our hiring team.

— — —

Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un leader d'affaires opérationnel pour gérer et faire croître une unité d'affaires SaaS B2B au service du domaine des essais cliniques. Ce poste combine la pleine responsabilité du compte de résultats (P&L) avec la responsabilité de l'excellence opérationnelle, de la prestation aux clients, de l'efficacité organisationnelle et de la transformation axée sur l'IA.

Le candidat retenu est avant tout un opérateur. Il a conçu et amélioré des systèmes, rationalisé des organisations, mis en œuvre l'automatisation et généré des résultats d'affaires mesurables. Il est à l'aise pour passer de la prise de décision au niveau de la direction à l'exécution opérationnelle détaillée.

Ce leader travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Services professionnels, Réussite client et Finances afin d'améliorer la performance de l'entreprise tout en bâtissant un modèle d'exploitation plus évolutif et activé par l'IA.

Vos responsabilités

Performance de l'entreprise

  • Assumer la responsabilité de la performance financière de l'unité d'affaires, y compris les revenus, la marge brute, les coûts d'exploitation et la rentabilité.
  • Élaborer et exécuter des plans d'exploitation qui équilibrent les résultats pour les clients et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Affiner les indicateurs de performance et la responsabilisation à l'échelle des fonctions.

IA et transformation opérationnelle

  • Diriger l'adoption de l'IA et de l'automatisation dans les flux de travail destinés aux clients et internes.
  • Repérer les occasions d'éliminer les processus manuels, de réduire la complexité organisationnelle et d'accroître la productivité.
  • Promouvoir une approche axée sur l'IA au sein des équipes.
  • Établir des cibles mesurables de gains de productivité et de levier opérationnel.

Prestation aux clients et opérations

  • Améliorer la qualité de la prestation, le taux d'utilisation, l'évolutivité et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
  • Bâtir des processus reproductibles qui réduisent la dépendance envers les contributeurs individuels.
  • Favoriser l'amélioration continue grâce aux données, à la refonte des processus et à la technologie.

Leadership interfonctionnel

  • Aligner les équipes Produit, Ingénierie, Réussite client, Services professionnels et Opérations sur des objectifs d'affaires communs.
  • Traduire les priorités stratégiques en exécution opérationnelle.
  • Éliminer les obstacles et améliorer l'efficacité organisationnelle.
  • Diriger les revues d'affaires et les cadences d'exploitation.

Développement de l'équipe

  • Bâtir des équipes à haut niveau de responsabilisation, axées sur les résultats.
  • Encadrer les gestionnaires et former les futurs leaders.
  • Cultiver une culture d'appropriation, de transparence, d'amélioration continue et d'expérimentation.

À quoi ressemble la réussite

Au cours des 12 premiers mois, ce leader aura :

  • Accru la productivité organisationnelle grâce aux initiatives d'IA et d'automatisation.
  • Simplifié les processus d'exploitation et réduit la complexité dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.
  • Amélioré la marge brute et l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Accru la fidélisation de la clientèle et l'efficacité de la prestation.
  • Établi un modèle d'exploitation évolutif capable de soutenir la croissance future.
  • Bâti une culture de responsabilisation, d'appropriation et d'amélioration continue.

Cette offre concerne un poste vacant actuellement à pourvoir. Nous utilisons des outils d'intelligence artificielle (IA) pour aider au tri, à l'évaluation et/ou à la sélection des candidatures dans le cadre de notre processus d'embauche; les décisions finales sont examinées par notre équipe de recrutement.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 8+ years of leadership experience in software or SaaS businesses.
  • Proven experience leading operational functions such as Professional Services, Customer Operations, Customer Success, Operations, Business Operations, IT, Delivery, or similar.
  • Demonstrated ownership of budgets, business performance metrics, or P&L responsibilities.

  • Track record of driving measurable productivity improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across technical and business teams.

Preferred

  • Experience in life sciences, clinical research, healthcare technology, regulatory software, or adjacent industries.
  • Experience in private-equity-backed software companies.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tooling, workflow automation platforms, and data-driven operating models.

— — —

Exigences

  • Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en leadership dans des entreprises de logiciels ou de SaaS.
  • Expérience confirmée de la direction de fonctions opérationnelles telles que les services professionnels, les opérations clients, les opérations de réussite client, les opérations d'affaires, les TI, la livraison ou des fonctions semblables.
  • Responsabilité démontrée de budgets, d'indicateurs de performance d'affaires ou d'un compte de résultats (P&L).
  • Expérience de la mise en œuvre de l'automatisation, d'améliorations de systèmes ou de flux de travail activés par l'IA.
  • Bilan probant en matière d'amélioration mesurable de la productivité et de l'efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et financières.
  • Expérience de la direction d'initiatives interfonctionnelles au sein d'équipes techniques et d'affaires.

Atouts

  • Expérience dans les sciences de la vie, la recherche clinique, les technologies de la santé, les logiciels réglementaires ou des secteurs connexes.
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises de logiciels détenues par des sociétés de capital-investissement.
  • Connaissance des outils d'IA modernes, des plateformes d'automatisation des flux de travail et des modèles d'exploitation axés sur les données.

ABOUT THE TEAM / À PROPOS DE L'ÉQUIPE

About Anju Software

Anju Software delivers end-to-end solutions for the life sciences industry, supporting clinical trials, medical affairs, and scientific data management with precision, compliance, and operational rigor. Our products help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies bring therapies to market faster and more efficiently.

jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Join the team transforming 150+ software companies with AI ABOUT VALSOFT:Valsoft is a global firm that acquires and grows mission-critical vertical market software companies.
jobs.description:
Join the team transforming 150+ software companies with AI

ABOUT VALSOFT:

Valsoft is a global firm that acquires and grows mission-critical vertical market software companies. Since 2015, we have built a portfolio of 150+ companies across 30+ industries, comprising 4,000+ employees in over 20 countries.

We're building the infrastructure, tools, and talent to make every business in our portfolio AI-native. We're hiring across 150+ vertical market software businesses in the Valsoft portfolio. The right candidate will be matched to a specific business where they can have an outsized impact from day one and an opportunity to work across multiple businesses over time.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

Engineers at Valsoft go where the hardest problems are — embedded directly inside portfolio companies, working alongside operators, product teams, and customers to solve complex, messy, high-stakes challenges that can't be fixed from a distance.

As an AI Automation Engineer, you'll be the person who figures out how to make a business run better end to end. The product, internal ops, customer experience, back office — if it's manual and repeatable, it's your target. You're not here to consult. You're here to build and ship.

What you’ll do

  • Embed inside portfolio companies to audit their workflows across every department and identify automation opportunities
  • Translate messy, manual processes into clean, reliable automated systems — using AI, no-code, custom code, or whatever actually works
  • Interview stakeholders, map processes, and diagnose root causes before writing a line of code
  • Build and deploy automation across operations, sales, customer support, reporting, and internal tooling
  • Own the full delivery cycle: scoping, building, shipping, measuring, and iterating
  • Work directly with company leadership to prioritize what gets built and communicate ROI clearly
  • Operate across multiple portfolio companies over time, building a repeatable playbook for what works

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience automating real business workflows — not just experiments, but things that shipped and stuck
  • Fluency across automation tooling: you know when to use Make, Zapier, n8n, custom code, or an AI agent — and you pick the right one
  • Strong technical foundation — you can build production-quality solutions, not just prototypes
  • Exceptional problem-framing skills: you ask the right questions before jumping to solutions
  • High comfort with ambiguity — you thrive when the brief is "this is costing us time but we don't know why"
  • Strong communicator — you can explain what you built, why it works, and what it's worth to non-technical leadership
  • Self-starter who moves fast and leaves systems better than you found them

What success looks like

  • Within 30 days: You've completed a full workflow audit and have a clear, prioritized automation roadmap
  • Within 90 days: At least two high-impact automations are live and driving measurable time or cost savings
  • Within 6 months: You're a trusted resource with a track record of shipped solutions and real outcomes
  • Long-term: You've built a repeatable playbook that defines how Valsoft operationalizes automation across its businesses — and you've got the metrics to prove it

jobs.description:
About Trevor:

The Trevor Project is the leading suicide prevention and crisis intervention organization for LGBTQ+ young people. Trevor offers 24/7 crisis services, connecting highly trained counselors with LGBTQ+ young people whenever they need support. To drive prevention efforts, The Trevor Project also operates robust research, advocacy, education, and peer support programs. We've been saving lives every day for over 25 years.
Every day, and in every role, our staff contribute to our critical mission of ending suicide among lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer & questioning young people by embodying our values:

  • Heart – We care deeply and commit to do what matters
  • Integrity – We build trust through our words and actions
  • Community – Together, we are an unstoppable force for good
  • Belonging – We serve as allies to the mission, and to each other
  • Progress – We continually move onward and upward

Title: Director, Total Rewards

Reports to: Chief People Officer

Location: This role will be remote in the continental US, Alaska, or Hawaii
FLSA Status: Exempt
Hours: Full-time
Union Status: Non-Union
Salary Range: $125,000–$140,000

Summary:
The Director, Total Rewards is a foundational leadership role responsible for shaping the strategy, structure, and sustainability of how The Trevor Project rewards, supports, and invests in its people. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this leader will define and lead Trevor's enterprise-wide approach to compensation, benefits, payroll, and recognition— establishing the philosophy, infrastructure, and governance that an evolving and mission-driven workforce requires.

This role is both highly strategic and deeply hands-on. The Director will be an architect in Trevor's Total Rewards philosophy, compensation structure, wellness and retirement benefits plan, and recognition and rewards programs that bring Trevor's values to life through the employee experience across a fully-remote workforce comprised of union and non-union staff and 24/7 shift workers. The Director will also oversee related operations and compliance functions.

The Director will lead and mentor a team of two — the Sr. Payroll Manager and the Benefits & Compensation Manager — while partnering closely with the Chief People Officer on overall strategy. This leader will serve as a trusted advisor in collaboration with executives, people managers, and cross-functional partners across Legal, Internal Communications, and Finance, bringing technical depth, sound judgment, and a collaborative posture to every decision.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise across the full Total Rewards discipline and is energized by the opportunity to build durable, equitable, and values-aligned reward systems.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Total Rewards Strategy & Philosophy

  • Define, codify, and socialize Trevor's Total Rewards philosophy, including pay positioning, internal equity stance, transparency commitments, and alignment with Trevor's mission and values
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer to translate workforce strategy into multi-year compensation, benefits, and payroll plans, surfacing the data and analysis needed to inform organizational budgeting
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to executive leadership on the total rewards implications of organizational decisions, growth plans, and structural change
  • Establish the metrics, dashboards, and governance reporting needed to bring visibility, accountability, and continuous improvement to the Total Rewards function
Compensation Strategy & Architecture
  • Oversee Trevor's pay bands, job architecture, and leveling framework to support equity, growth pathways, and clarity of expectations across roles
  • Design and lead Trevor's annual compensation and promotion cycles, including the rate structure for annual increases, merit, and recognition
  • Establish standards for setting compensation ranges for new and existing roles using market data, internal equity, and compensation frameworks
  • Provide strategic guidance to leaders and People Business Partners on offers, retention arrangements, promotions, and incentive design
Benefits, Retirement & Wellbeing
  • Lead the strategy, design, and annual planning of Trevor's health, welfare, retirement, and wellbeing programs to ensure they are competitive, equitable, and reflective of Trevor's commitment to its people
  • Spearhead ERISA compliance, Form 5500 filings, ACA reporting, and nondiscrimination testing, ensuring audit readiness across all benefit programs
  • Own and strengthen Trevor's benefits and compensation vendor partnerships and assess whether existing benefits technology is being leveraged to its fullest potential
  • Partner with Internal Communications to elevate awareness, accessibility, and utilization of Trevor's benefits and wellbeing offerings
Recognition & Rewards
  • Cultivate Trevor's formal employee recognition program, designing a framework that reflects Trevor's values and reinforces a culture of belonging, trust, and progress
  • Partner closely with the Director, Talent & Inclusion to integrate recognition into the broader employee experience and culture strategy
Payroll Strategy & Multi-State Compliance
  • Set the strategic direction for payroll operations, with the Sr. Payroll Manager owning execution across multi-state payroll processing, garnishments, retirement contributions, reconciliation, and reporting
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with multi-state labor, unemployment, disability, and workers' compensation registrations, and oversee payroll-related partnerships with tax authorities and external vendors
  • Establish a payroll reporting and variance-analysis cadence that supports budget monitoring, financial audit readiness, and informed organizational decision-making
Leave, Accommodations & Compliance Governance
  • Cultivate a sustainable, equitable, and compassionate framework for leave and accommodations across multiple states within a 24/7, shift-based work environment
Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Sr. Payroll Manager and Benefits & Compensation Manager, providing the mentorship, stability, and best-practice guidance needed to elevate the function
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team environment grounded in trust, clarity, integrity, and technical excellence
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, and centralized ownership for Total Rewards processes
  • Build sustainable processes, documentation, and playbooks that outlast individual tenure and enable the function to scale
Organizational Partnership & Operations
  • Navigate Trevor's highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, building strong partnerships with Finance, Legal, Internal Communications, and other members of the People team
  • Contribute to organizational change management, process improvement, and operational stabilization efforts across the People function
  • Ensure all programs and practices align with organizational values, applicable laws and regulations, union considerations, and equitable workplace practices
  • Approach all work and interactions with empathy and inclusion, to create relationships with teams and individuals at all levels, working closely with colleagues to brainstorm ideas, discuss pros/cons, and develop ways forward, listening and responding to develop mutual understanding and trust
  • Communicate clearly - both in written and verbal form - for internal audiences, distilling complex information into compelling, easily digestible narratives; conveying information around policies, legal and compliance considerations, and best practices in a way that is understood by staff at all levels
  • Work collaboratively with relevant external partners
  • Demonstrate a commitment to fostering and maintaining an environment of inclusion and belonging, modeling Trevor’s values and enhancing culture in everyday interactions as well as operational initiatives
  • Maintaining knowledge competency relating to The Trevor Project’s programs, services, and strategic goals, as well as the LGBTQ+ community we serve
  • Demonstrate fair, ethical, and equitable business practices
  • Handle sensitive and confidential matters with the utmost discretion and integrity, with regard for cultural, operational, and legal considerations
  • Learn eagerly, share knowledge appropriately, and improve continuously
  • Demonstrate successful planning and problem-solving skills, including multitasking and working well within tight timelines
  • Demonstrate attention to detail and accuracy in all work
  • Handle other relevant duties and responsibilities as assigned
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 8+ years of progressive Total Rewards experience, including direct ownership of compensation, benefits, and payroll strategy within complex, multi-state nonprofit organizations
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming Total Rewards programs — including authoring compensation philosophies, designing pay structures, and establishing job architecture — within evolving, growing, or mission-driven environments
  • Deep technical expertise across benefits administration, retirement plan management, 5500 filings, ACA and nondiscrimination testing, and multi-state payroll compliance
  • Experience administering total rewards programs within a unionized environment under a collective bargaining agreement including 24/7 and shift-based staff
  • Demonstrated experience leading leaves and accommodations across multiple states, including mental-health-related accommodations and shift-based workforce considerations
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams, including mentoring and coaching managers and individual contributors
  • Demonstrated ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution in fast-paced, evolving environments
  • Strong project management and operational planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously
  • Strong analytical capability, including advanced Excel skills and experience leveraging HRIS and Total Rewards technology to inform strategy, reporting, and decision-making
  • Exceptional communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills across all organizational levels
  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English
  • Experience supporting Total Rewards within global or internationally distributed organizations is preferred
  • Demonstrated commitment to fostering inclusive, equitable, and mission-aligned workplace practices
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, organizational change, and evolving priorities with professionalism and sound judgment
  • Strong emotional intelligence, integrity, discretion, and ability to build trust across diverse teams and stakeholders
  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus

The Trevor Project complies with all applicable laws regarding equal opportunity in employment.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging

Nonprofit HR is committed to fostering and maintaining a work environment where diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are fully integrated into everything we do for the benefit of our employees and the clients that we serve. At Scalable.co, we help entrepreneurs build businesses that run and grow without them so they can achieve their ideal exit without sacrificing their soul in the process.

As a Scalable Business Advisor (SBA), you’ll guide a portfolio of 75–90 founders, CEOs, and executives through proven systems that help them scale their companies. You won’t be a "guru" or therapist; you’ll be a strategic facilitator and accountability partner helping business owners implement, execute, and scale.

Using our proprietary tools, frameworks, and planning rhythms, you’ll help founders stay focused, make better decisions, and build the infrastructure needed to grow with less chaos and more clarity.

This is a full-time, remote role that’s ideal for someone who loves entrepreneurs, thrives on results, and finds fulfillment in helping companies grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Work one-on-one with 75–90 founders, CEOs, and executives, helping them apply Scalable’s frameworks to solve operational bottlenecks
  • Facilitate bi-weekly implementation sessions, helping customize and install the Scalable Operating System™ into our client's companies during the 16-week Get Scalable Accelerator™

  • Clients feel challenged, supported, and energized after each session

Benefits

Full-Time employees are eligible for health and welfare benefits.

  • Competitive Salary + Performance-Based Compensation
  • Health, Dental, + Vision Insurance
  • HSA plan with Company Matching (for eligible HDHP enrollees)
  • Company-Paid Telemedicine Plan
  • Company-Paid Mental Wellness, Financial Wellness, + Legal Counseling services
  • Company-Paid Life and Disability Insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 401K Plan with Company Matching
  • Parental leave
  • and more...


About The Scalable Company:

At The Scalable Company (), we’re building an ecosystem of tools and services any entrepreneur can plug into to scale their companies and themselves. By combining best-in-class models and frameworks with access to peer masterminds and world-class mentors, we increase the odds of a successful outcome for entrepreneurs, their families, and their teams and customers.

We deliver our flagship 16-week program, the Get Scalable Accelerator, as well two different flagship 12-month backend programs, the Scale & Exit Accelerator and Founders Board Mastermind – each of which are designed for bootstrapped entrepreneurs at different stages of their business. We also host an annual event, Get Scalable Live, that brings together entrepreneurs from all over the world to network and spend valuable time working above their business.

You can read more about our company and our mission by reading our manifesto, here.

Our Core Values:

1. We love entrepreneurs. Entrepreneurs are innovators and job creators. They take risks that most people would call “crazy,” and the best ones (the ones we get to work with) take all the blame when things go wrong and give away all the credit when things go right. We believe it’s an honor and a privilege to play a small role in helping them make a “dent” in their corner of the universe. (NOTE: If we get this one right, we can get a lot of other things wrong.)

2. We are “batteries included.” While we love praise and reward, neither are required for us to do our best work. We show up and bring our best because that’s who we are, not because someone else “motivated” or “inspired” us to act that way.

3. We raise the bar. Our past successes don't define us any more than our past failures, which is why we work to get a little better every day. We have high standards for ourselves and our team, we never stop learning, and when we have the opportunity to hire someone smarter and more talented than us...WE DO IT!

4. We do the dishes. No work is beneath us if it serves our teammates and our customers.

5. We seek the why. "That's how we've always done it..." is NEVER an acceptable response. Whether things go right or things go wrong, we always ask, “Why?”


Why You Might Be Excited About Us

  • Like us, you believe entrepreneurs make the world a better place, and you’re excited about our mission to eradicate entrepreneurial imposter syndrome and help more small businesses succeed.
  • Like us, you like the idea of working remotely and having more flexibility in your schedule.
  • Like us, you enjoy driving new projects and making direct contributions to the company’s success and mission.
  • Like us, you crave the idea of “owning a number” and having objective proof of your value to the team.
  • Like us, you enjoy having access to some of the smartest, most successful, (and even famous) entrepreneurs and business owners in the world. (At the end of the day, our mutant power is community-building, so you never know who’s going to show up at our meetings and events.)


Why You Might NOT Be Excited About Us

  • We’re fairly small (~25 people), so if you like more hierarchy and levels of management in a bigger company, this role isn’t for you.
  • We don’t have it all figured out. As a bootstrapped, entrepreneurial-driven startup, there are many areas of the company where we’re still “building the rocket on the way up.” So, if you require a tested and proven playbook to perform every aspect of your job, then this probably isn’t the place for you.
  • We work really, really hard. Everyone on the team is extremely mission-driven, and works incredibly hard to achieve our “comfortably-uncomfortable” goals. While we DON’T believe in working weekends or pulling “all-nighters” as a normal course of business, if you want a cushy, 40-hour per week job, you probably won’t like it here.
  • We change our minds, pivot fast, and embrace change when change is needed. We aren’t flakes, nor do we seek chaos for chaos’ sake. But we WILL shift projects and priorities when presented with new data, so, again, if you need to work at a company that “has it all figured out,” we’re not the place for you.
  • We don’t micro-manage. This is not the kind of job where you show up and we tell you exactly what to do every day. We need people who can manage their own calendar and who aren’t afraid to Google something if they don’t know how to do it. In other words, if you need to know EXACTLY what you will be doing every hour of the day, week over week, we’re probably not a good fit.


The Scalable Company provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, The Scalable Company complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Job Title: Director of Finance
